en.audience: The affected population is the residents of the four countries who bear taxes,public-service opportunity costs,and security risks-a constructed hundred-million-scale impact reach. The direct actors are the four governments,legislatures,and alliance institutions,not people repeating a weekly action. This card does not disguise an institutional response as mass adoption;It asks which institutional tool public power uses first.
en.falsifier: Any one of the following falsifies the corresponding claim:(1) by 31 December 2031,at least three countries have qualifying triggers,but fewer than three have A as their first A/B response (B-first or an A/B tie is not A-first);(2) by 31 December 2031,at least three countries have qualifying triggers,but at least three of them have no A-class document within 365 days after the trigger,or their first A/B response is not A-this would refute the forward direction that A comes before B;(3) a country with only a generic NATO annual pathway and no qualifying national trigger is not counted as a hit or a counterexample;if fewer than three countries have triggers,the card is undecidable. The A/B comparison does not silently count other security executive orders,information controls,or emergency laws;if the trigger date,the law’s security rationale,the document class,or strict ordering cannot be judged,that country is undecidable rather than counted as a hit.
en.judgment: From 2026-10-16 to 2031-12-31,record for each of the United Kingdom,France,Germany,and Italy its first qualifying security trigger in the window:a national government or legislature publishes an official security/defence document explicitly naming a new external threat or a new alliance defence commitment,or an official record documents an external armed event;a generic NATO annual document is not a country’s trigger. For each country with a qualifying trigger,compare only two pre-registered response classes within 365 days of the trigger’s public date:(A) an annual defence appropriation,procurement,or industrial-policy document;(B) an electoral-rule or constitutional power-distribution law whose security rationale is explicit. Other security executive orders,information controls,or emergency laws are logged separately and are not silently treated as A or B. If at least three countries have triggers,at least three of them will have A as the first A/B response,not B. If fewer than three countries have a qualifying trigger by 31 December 2031,this card is undecidable;the absence of triggers is not counted as a hit.
en.leading_indicator: NATO annual defence-expenditure tables and the 2029 review;annual core-defence and ODA appropriations in the four countries;publication dates of defence procurement and domestic defence-industry/supply-chain policies;explicit references to an external security rationale in government bill notes;dates of electoral-law,constitutional-amendment,and security-policy documents. A/B is first only when an official date or timestamp is strictly earlier;the same date without a timestamp or official sequence is a tie,and that country is not counted as A-first. Check annually and once after a major security event.
en.reasoning_chain: External security pressure requires executable collective commitments → NATO has written targets,annual pathways,and a review into alliance documents,while the UK has written defence expansion and an ODA reshuffle into its budget narrative → governments can use budgets,procurement,and industrial policy through existing powers and spread their cost annually → changing electoral rules or constitutional power distribution requires legislative majorities,judicial review,and a higher level of political conflict → therefore,in a window anchored to each country’s official trigger and fixed at 365 days,security pressure is more likely to appear first as budgetary and industrial arrangements than as the first response in electoral rules. AI capability is not a premise.

zh.audience: 受影响人群是四国居民与承担税收、公共服务机会成本和安全风险的人,构造式亿量级;直接执行者是四国政府、议会与联盟机构,不是每周重复执行的个人动作。 本卡不把制度响应伪装成社会级普及
zh.falsifier: 以下任一条成立,即证伪对应主张:(1) 到 2031-12-31,至少三国具备合格触发事件,但其中少于三国的第一项 A/B 响应是 A(B 先行或 A/B 平手都不算 A-first);(2) 到 2031-12-31,至少有三国具备合格触发事件,但其中至少三国没有在触发事件后 365 天内出现 A 类文件,或其第一项 A/B 响应不是 A--这会否定“A 先于 B”的前瞻方向;(3) 任何国家若只有北约一般性年度路径、没有本国合格触发事件,不计作命中或反例;少于三国有触发事件时,本卡只记不可判定。 这里的 A/B 比较不把其他安全行政命令、信息控制或紧急法令偷偷算进来;若触发日期、法律的安全理由、文件类别或严格先后顺序不可判定,该国记为不可判定,不计作命中。
zh.judgment: 在 2026-10-16 至 2031-12-31 的窗口内,对英国、法国、德国、意大利分别记录窗口内第一次合格安全触发事件:本国政府或议会发布的官方安全/防务文件明确写出新的外部威胁或新的联盟防务承诺,或官方记录外部武装事件;北约一般性年度文件不算某一国触发事件。 对有合格触发事件的国家,从事件公开日期起 365 天内只比较两类预先登记的响应:(A) 年度国防拨款、采购或工业政策文件;(B) 安全理由明确写入的全国选举规则或宪法权力分配法律。 其他安全行政命令、信息控制或紧急法令单独记录,但不伪装成 A/B 之一。 若至少三国有触发事件,至少三国的第一项 A/B 响应将是 A,而不是 B。 若到 2031-12-31 少于三国有合格触发事件,本卡记为不可判定,不把缺少触发事件当作命中。
zh.leading_indicator: 北约年度国防开支表与 2029 年复核;四国年度预算中的核心国防拨款与 ODA;国防采购和本国军工/供应链政策发布日期;政府法案说明中对外部安全理由的明文引用;选举法、宪法修正案与安全政策文件的时间顺序。 A/B 只有在官方公布的日期或时间戳严格更早时才判为先行;同一日期但没有时间戳或官方先后顺序时记为平手、该国不计作 A-first。 每年检查,重大安全事件后追加一次。
zh.reasoning_chain: 外部安全压力需要可执行的集体承诺 → 北约已把目标、年度路径和复核写进联盟文件,英国已把国防增支与 ODA 重排写进政府预算叙事 → 政府可以直接使用预算、采购和产业政策这些已有权限,且成本可以按年度分摊 → 改变选举规则或宪法权力分配需要议会多数、司法审查和更高的政治冲突 → 因此在一个以本国官方触发事件为起点、长度固定为 365 天的窗口内,安全冲击首先表现为预算与产业安排,而不是选举制度的第一响应。 AI 能力不是本链前提。

en.audience: The impact reach includes commuter transport,office buildings and city-centre commerce,and is not counted in the denominator;the actual repeated actors are people at work who do at least part of their paid work at their own home in the reference week - the qualifying components of the US,the UK and New Zealand sum to about 48 million (broad definition;about 66 million with the EU added),tens-of-millions-scale,and the action is done by more than half of people at work within US standard breakdowns such as computer and mathematical,business and financial operations,and professional and technical services. it changes where people already employed do their work;4%,above the overall rate) was not measured.
en.falsifier: Any one of the following falsifies the corresponding part of this card:(1) over the most recent 12 months before 2029-10-10,the average telework rate in BLS’s Current Population Survey (people-at-work measure,Table A-41) is above 25% or below 19% (overturns “plateau”:the former is expansion,the latter contraction);(2) in any 12 consecutive months within the window,the average telework rate of BLS’s “computer and mathematical occupations” falls below 50% (overturns the continuation of the D-tier route “above half within a standard breakdown”);(3) a qualifying weekly survey with a reference period between 2023-01-01 and 2026-10-10 appears that brings the sum of qualifying components under the frozen rules to ≥ 100 million (overturns the C verdict of the “Current-scale review” - this is an overturn by measurement coverage,not behavioural expansion,and must be recorded separately from (1));(4) within the window the US or the UK legislates to let workers decide unilaterally to work from home (the employer may not refuse on business grounds),and one year after it takes effect that country’s telework share has still not risen out of its previous range (overturns “the employer’s decision right is a necessary premise”;if no such legislation occurs within the window,this item is recorded as undeterminable,not as passed).
en.judgment: As of 2026-10-10,“doing at least part of one’s paid work at one’s own home in the reference week” reaches only the D tier (segment diffusion) under the definitions frozen in advance:the qualifying components of the US,the UK and New Zealand sum to about 48 million (all broad definition;about 66 million with the EU added,whose base was not obtained),short of hundred-million weekly reach,and the action is done by more than half of people at work only within standard breakdowns such as the US computer and mathematical,and business and financial operations,occupation groups;through 2029-10-10 it stays on a plateau - the telework rate among US people at work neither expands above 25% nor falls back below 19%;whether people work at home is decided mainly by the employer,not by the person.
en.leading_indicator: The BLS Table A-41 monthly telework rate and the Table A-42 telework rates by occupation and by industry;the SWAA monthly series of the share of paid working days worked entirely at home;commuting trips per person in England's National Travel Survey;the ONS share who “worked from home in the past seven days”;the office-attendance-day requirements of major employers and governments and their enforcement;flexible-working legislation;whether national statistical agencies start publishing qualifying weekly working-from-home figures (Canada,Japan,China,India),and the EU employment base;annually.
en.reasoning_chain: The demand to commute less and arrange one’s own time has long existed (L8;no change in human nature required) → home broadband and personal devices had long since become common for other reasons (a constraint),and the forced shutdowns of 2020 gave employers their first large-scale test of working from home → workers value working from home as equivalent to a pay rise of about 8%,and voluntary repeat use held steady through 2023-2026 at more than three times the 2019 level (a constraint) → but working from home needs the employer’s consent (a constraint),and about four in ten people at work are in occupations that require being on site - service,construction,production,transportation - with telework rates of only 0. 9%-12. 8% (occupational structure) → so the scale stops at the tens of millions and is above half only in white-collar breakdowns (a constraint fails,D tier) → from 2025 the federal government and large employers tightened office-attendance requirements,and the telework rate moved sideways between 21. 5% and 23. 8% → within the window it stays on a plateau. AI is not part of this mechanism:delete AI and the conclusion holds unchanged.

en.judgment: From 2027-2038,contact transfer,exception observation,and standardised care assistance are more likely to form stable routines first in institutions and controlled home-care services;general-purpose robots in open-ended homes will not constitute social-scale diffusion in this window.

en.reasoning_chain: Repetitive tasks are easier to standardise → institutions concentrate procurement and training → liability,maintenance,and records can bind to an organisation → controlled settings stabilise first → heterogeneous homes,rare exceptions,and externalised liability slow general-purpose devices.

zh.leading_indicator: 按地区记录部署工时、维修半径、保险费率、设备留存、停机损失、能源稳定性与转岗结果;每年。
zh.reasoning_chain: 具身设备需要现场载体 → 载体在少数高工资或产业结构化地区先齐备 → 部署与维护网络形成学习效应 → 资本与人才进一步聚集 → 区域差异可能扩大,除非公共投资与制度扩散打断该反馈。

en.audience: Affected populations whose distribution of income,housing,education,care,and political choice is shaped by distribution are billion-scale;the countable action denominator is households tracked by income decile in comparable national panels for disposable income,net wealth,and housing burden,not a claim that the billion-scale affected population performs one weekly action
en.falsifier: If by 2035,in at least four economies spanning different institutions,productivity growth is accompanied by sustained improvement in bottom-40% households’ real disposable income,net wealth after debt,and housing burden,while asset returns and returns to complementary skills do not widen relative to bottom households-or if this improvement occurs mainly in economies without changes in bargaining power,public services,taxation,or broad asset ownership-then the claim that gains first differentiate claims and are then diffused through institutions is falsified;inconsistent definitions,averages without distribution,or a single-year observation are indeterminate.
en.judgment: From 2027 to 2035,in economies affected by high-productivity technologies,increased productivity or output will not automatically become sustainable income and wealth growth for most households;where housing,capital,and complementary-asset supply is constrained,gains are more likely first to appear in asset returns,rents on scarce positions,and returns to complementary skills,while bottom-household disposable capacity catches up only where bargaining power,public services,taxation,or broad asset ownership expand alongside productivity.
en.leading_indicator: Labour-income share,real disposable income,net wealth,and rent/debt burden by income and wealth decile;housing and land prices relative to wages;returns to complementary skills and assets;tax transfers and the in-kind value of public services;annual or quarterly.
en.reasoning_chain: technology and organization first raise productivity in some tasks → concentration of complementary assets such as housing,land,capital,finance,networks,and permits determines who obtains rents first → labour substitutability,bargaining power,occupational entry,mobility,and transfers determine whether income diffuses → wealth gaps feed back through housing,education,care,and waiting risk into the next generation → taxation,public services,labour institutions,and broad asset ownership can interrupt or amplify that feedback → productivity growth therefore first differentiates claims,while whether it becomes income and wealth growth for most households institutional and supply intermediaries.

zh.audience: 收入、住房、教育、照护与政治选择受分配影响的人群为十亿量级;可数行动分母=同一国家面板中按收入分位追踪的家庭实际可支配收入、净财富与住房负担,不把十亿量级受影响者冒充同一项周频行动者
zh.falsifier: 若到 2035 年,在至少 4 个覆盖不同制度的经济体中,生产率增长同时伴随底部 40% 家庭实际可支配收入、家庭净财富(扣除负债)和住房负担的持续改善,且资产回报与高互补技能回报没有相对底部家庭进一步扩大,或者改善主要发生在没有劳动议价、公共服务、税制或广泛资产持有变化的经济体,则“收益先分化取得权、再由制度决定扩散”的主张被证伪;数据口径不一致、只有平均数或只有单年观察时记为不可判定。
zh.judgment: 2027-2035 年,受高生产率技术影响的经济体中,生产率或产出增加不会自动转化为多数家庭可持续的收入与财富增长;在住房、资本和互补资产供给受限的地区,收益更可能先体现为资产回报、稀缺位置租金和高互补技能回报,只有在劳动议价、公共服务、税制或广泛资产持有同步扩张时,底部家庭的实际可支配能力才会跟上。
zh.leading_indicator: 按收入/财富分位的劳动收入份额、实际可支配收入、净财富与租金/偿债负担;住房与土地价格相对工资;高互补技能与资产回报;税收转移和公共服务实物价值;年度或季度。
zh.reasoning_chain: 技术与组织先提高部分任务的生产率 → 住房、土地、资本、融资、网络和许可证等互补资产的集中决定谁先取得租金 → 劳动可替代性、议价权、职业入口、流动性与制度转移决定收入是否扩散 → 财富差距通过住房、教育、照护与等待风险反馈到下一代 → 税制、公共服务、劳动制度与广泛资产持有可打断或放大这一反馈 → 因而生产率上升先分化取得权,是否成为多数家庭的收入与财富增长取决于制度和供给中介。

en.audience: actual repeated actors/behaviour denominator = not applicable,because this card judges institutional carrying capacity rather than personal action
en.falsifier: “working-age migrant share reaches the registered baseline” means it reaches that country’s 2019 value;and “does not rise” means the care-vacancy rate and housing-burden rate stay within 2 percentage points of their 2019-2025 mean and credential-recognition waiting time stays within 110% of that mean. If at least three of those countries have positive net migration for three consecutive years,reach the working-age baseline,return the old-age dependency ratio to its 2019 level or below,and keep all three carrying indicators within those thresholds,the strong form “migration only buffers,it cannot reverse age structure” is refuted;missing baseline data is indeterminate.
en.judgment: From 2026 to 2032,major OECD receiving countries will continue using permanent and temporary migration to ease labour and care shortages;migration can improve local ratios of working-age people to service demand but cannot restore the old age structure within one generation,and the receiving place’s constraints will move toward housing,credential recognition,language,schools,job quality,and political integration.
en.leading_indicator: OECD International Migration Outlook data on permanent and temporary migration,work permits,and family reunification;working-age net migration;care vacancies and wages;migrant housing burden,credential-recognition waiting times,and local school capacity;annually.
en.reasoning_chain: Ageing reduces the local supply of new workers → health,care,construction,and service jobs still need people → migration can change the geography of working-age population within years → migrants also need housing,schools,and training → the buffer concentrates where carrying and credential systems exist → higher net migration does not restore the old dependency ratio because migrants age too and the required scale accumulates over time.

zh.audience: 实际重复执行者/行为分母=不适用,本卡判断制度承载而非个人动作
zh.falsifier: 「工作年龄迁移者占比达到登记基线」为达到该国 2019 年值;「没有上升」为照护岗位空缺率和住房负担率不超过 2019-2025 年均值 2 个百分点,资格认证等待时间不超过该均值的 110%。 若这些国家中有至少三个净迁移连续三年为正、工作年龄占比达到基线,且老年抚养比回到 2019 年水平或更低,同时三项承载指标均在阈值内,才证伪「迁移只能缓冲、不能逆转年龄结构」的强形式;若基线数据缺失,记为不可判定。
zh.judgment: 2026-2032 年,OECD 主要接收国会继续用永久与临时迁移缓解劳动力和照护缺口;迁移能改善工作年龄人口与服务需求的局部比率,但不能在一代内把老年抚养比恢复到过去水平,接收地的瓶颈会转向住房、资格互认、语言、学校、岗位质量与政治整合。
zh.leading_indicator: OECD International Migration Outlook 的永久与临时迁移、工作许可和家庭团聚数据;劳动年龄净迁移;照护岗位空缺和工资;迁移者住房负担、资格认证等待期与地方学校容量;每年。
zh.reasoning_chain: 老龄化减少本地新增劳动者 → 医疗、照护、建筑和服务岗位仍需有人完成 → 迁移是几年内可以改变劳动年龄人口分布的渠道 → 迁移者也需要住房、学校、身份和培训 → 供给缓冲会集中在能承载和认证的地区与职业 → 净迁入增加不等于抚养比回到旧水平,因为迁移者也会老去,所需规模随时间累积。

en.audience: actual repeated actors/behaviour denominator = not applicable,because this card judges an institutional relationship between housing costs and family formation rather than one weekly deduplicated social action
en.falsifier: Pre-register “high pressure” as an OECD-comparable price-to-income ratio or rent burden in the top quartile of the target urban sample;“sustained population inflow” as a net inflow rate of at least 0. 5% per year for three consecutive years;and “material fall” as a three-year-average fall relative to the 2023-2025 baseline of at least 0. 2 years in age at first independent residence or first birth,or 2 percentage points in childlessness,supported by a 95% interval on the same statistical definition. If any urban area lacks the required age,childlessness,or 95% -interval measure,exclude that urban area;if fewer than three complete urban areas remain,record indeterminate rather than treating missingness as non-refutation. If at least three urban areas meeting the first two conditions also meet those fall conditions,the direction that housing stress keeps delaying family formation is refuted;if housing stress falls but family formation does not recover,it refutes housing as the main constraint,not every other constraint.
en.judgment: From 2026 to 2032,housing-cost pressure in the high-income OECD member-country urban sample will continue to delay first independent residence,cohabitation/marriage,and first births,concentrating family formation in fewer affordable places;housing,childcare,and transport policy can buffer the mechanism but will not return every household to the previous generation’s floor area and geography.
en.leading_indicator: OECD price-to-income and rent-burden measures;age at first independent residence,age at first birth,and childlessness;urban housing permits and net population inflow;annually.
en.reasoning_chain: Jobs and education concentrate in cities → households pay higher prices and rents for access → young adults delay independent residence or move family formation farther away → commuting,care,and childcare time rise → the same income must cover housing and children → only housing supply,public childcare,transport,or predictable income can loosen the combined constraint;in-migration first raises competition in scarce places rather than automatically creating affordable homes.

zh.audience: 实际重复执行者/行为分母=不适用,本卡判断住房成本与家庭形成的制度关系,不是一个按周去重的社会动作
zh.falsifier: 预先把「住房压力高」定义为目标都市区 OECD 可比房价收入比或租金负担处于样本前四分位;「人口持续流入」定义为连续三年净流入率至少为年均 0. 5%;「显著下降」定义为相对 2023-2025 基线的三年平均首次独立居住年龄或首胎年龄下降至少 0. 2 年、无子比例下降至少 2 个百分点,并由同一统计口径的 95% 置信区间支持。 若任一都市区缺少所需年龄、无子比例或 95% 置信区间,则排除该都市区;完整都市区少于三个时记为不可判定,不把缺失视为未证伪。 若至少三个满足前两项的都市区同时满足这些下降条件,住房压力持续把家庭形成推迟的方向被证伪;住房压力下降而家庭形成不回升,则只否定住房是主要约束,不否定其他约束。
zh.judgment: 2026-2032 年,高收入 OECD 成员国城市样本的住房成本压力会继续推迟首次独立居住、同居/结婚与首胎,并把家庭形成分化到更少数的可负担地点;住房、托育与交通政策可以缓冲,但不会把所有家庭带回上一代的居住面积和地理位置。
zh.leading_indicator: OECD 房价收入比与租金负担;首次独立居住年龄、首胎年龄、无子比例;都市区新增住房许可与人口净流入;每年。
zh.reasoning_chain: 就业和教育机会集中于城市 → 家庭为机会支付更高房价与租金 → 年轻人推迟独立居住或把家庭形成迁到更远地点 → 通勤、照护和托育时间上升 → 同一笔收入同时面对住房与育儿支出 → 只有增加住房供给、公共托育、交通或可预期收入,才会松开这个组合约束;人口流入会先抬高紧缺地点的竞争,不会自动增加可负担住房。

en.audience: a million-scale set of manufacturing,procurement,insurance,finance,equipment,and infrastructure professionals performs the work;downstream consumers are a larger indirect reach.
en.falsifier: Before 2032,at least three manufacturing regions have each experienced repeated climate-related qualified-output loss that inventory or qualified alternate paths could not absorb;if,under that condition,semiconductor insurance terms,supplier contracts,qualification,inventory structure,financing cost,and siting standards show no systematic change,or changes follow hazard maps alone and remain unrelated to output loss and alternate-path qualification,the card fails. **If the loss trigger never occurs by the end of the 2034 window,but insurance terms,financing cost,or siting standards have systematically changed based only on hazard maps or disclosure regulation,the card also fails. ** Repeated water,power,logistics,or site interruptions that are fully absorbed,and a trigger that never occurs without this kind of prior pricing,do not trigger falsification.
en.judgment: From 2027 to 2034,semiconductor procurement,insurance,finance,and siting will systematically price climate risk,but the testable transmission unit is not the number of facilities in hazard zones:it is at least one multi-site qualified-output loss,longer alternate-path qualification,or related supplier interruption that inventory or qualified alternate paths cannot absorb;if the window ends without that transmission but pricing has changed based only on hazard maps or disclosure regulation,the judgment is falsified.
en.leading_indicator: climate-related downtime and lost wafers,insurance deductibles and exclusions,climate audit clauses,alternate-source qualification time,common-node exposure,and post-event contract or siting changes;annually.
en.reasoning_chain: a climate event is not a production loss → exposure damages output only through water,power,logistics,equipment service,or supplier nodes → inventory and qualified alternatives absorb part of the shock → only repeated,unabsorbed qualified transmission can change premiums,contracts,inventory,and siting;**no current source establishes that this transmission will occur inside the window,so its absence before expiry is neither a nor automatically a falsification and must be reviewed against the preregistered conditions;if the loss trigger is absent but hazard-map or disclosure-regulation prior pricing appears,the symmetric falsifier applies**.

zh.audience: 下游消费者为更大的间接受影响面。
zh.falsifier: 在 2032 年前,至少三个制造区域都出现了重复、气候相关、且无法由库存或已验证替代路径吸收的已验证产出损失;若在此前提下半导体保险条款、供应合同、资格验证、库存结构、融资成本和选址标准仍无系统变化,或变化只跟风险地图走、与实际产出损失和替代路径无关,则本卡证伪。 **若到 2034 年窗口结束前,上述损失从未出现,却已有保险条款、融资成本或选址标准仅按风险地图或披露监管系统性变化,本卡同样证伪。 **反复发生但被完全吸收的水、电、物流或场址中断,以及触发器从未出现且没有这类先行定价,均不触发证伪。
zh.judgment: 2027-2034 年,半导体采购、保险、融资与选址会把气候风险系统性纳入定价,但可被检验的传导单位不是风险区厂房数量,而是至少一种无法由库存或已验证替代路径吸收的多场址已验证产出损失、替代路径验证周期延长或相关供应商中断;若窗口结束前没有这类传导却已仅按风险地图或披露监管定价,本判断证伪。
zh.leading_indicator: 气候相关停机小时与损失晶圆、保险免赔额与除外条款、气候附加审计、替代来源验证周期、相关节点共同暴露、事件后选址或合同变化;每年。
zh.reasoning_chain: 气候事件不等于停产 → 暴露只有穿过水、电、物流、设备服务或供应商节点才损伤产出 → 库存与已验证替代路径可吸收部分冲击 → 只有重复且不可吸收的已验证传导才可能改变保费、合同、库存和选址;**当前没有来源证明这类传导会在窗口内出现,窗口尚未结束时不构成命中或证伪并保持;到期复核时只有预登记量无法计算才记;若损失触发器未出现却已有风险地图/披露监管先行定价,则按对称证伪条件判错**。

en.audience: constructed hundred-millions-scale reach across employees,customers,and citizens affected by high-liability automation
en.falsifier: By 2030,across at least three high-liability industries,most production autonomous systems receive broad high-liability authority without principal-level authorization,tamper-evident action records,human pause,and dispute appeal as prior production dependencies. If systems receive broad authority first and regulators or buyers tighten only after accidents,the reversed order still falsifies the card.
en.judgment: From 2026 to 2032,identity,permission,logging,pause,audit,and appeal enter core production systems before tool-using AI broadly receives high-liability autonomous authority.
en.leading_indicator: fine-grained permission coverage,log retention,human pause rate,external-audit clauses,appeal latency,and procurements rejected for missing controls;semi-annually.
en.reasoning_chain: Tool use enlarges possible consequences → asset owners require least privilege and interruptibility → disputes require logs,accountable signatures,and appeal → the control plane moves from compliance attachment to production dependency.

zh.audience: 受高责任自动化影响的员工、客户与公民为构造式亿量级
zh.falsifier: 到 2030 年,在至少三个高责任行业,大多数生产级自主系统在取得广泛高责任权限时仍未把主体级授权、不可篡改操作记录、人工暂停和争议申诉入口作为前置生产依赖。 若系统先广泛取得权限、事故后才被监管或买方收紧,仍因次序相反触发本卡证伪。
zh.judgment: 2026-2032 年,能持续调用工具的 AI 广泛获得高责任自主权之前,身份、权限、日志、暂停、审计与申诉进入核心生产系统。
zh.leading_indicator: 细粒度权限覆盖率、日志留存、人工暂停率、外部审计条款、申诉时延、因缺控制面被拒的采购;每半年。
zh.reasoning_chain: 工具调用扩大可造成的后果 → 资产所有者要求最小权限与可暂停性 → 争议要求日志、责任签名与申诉 → 控制面从合规附件变成生产依赖。

en.audience: Affected population = residents and cross-border service users,a billion-scale impact reach touched by data flows,infrastructure dependence,and institutional-zone differences;actual repeated actors/behaviour denominator = staff and institutions representing states,platforms,or critical-infrastructure organizations that execute cross-border licensing,procurement,standards,or supply switches monthly
en.falsifier: Pre-register at least three materially different jurisdictions and one common transaction set containing at least one cross-border data transfer,compute service,and critical-infrastructure service;each transaction class must use one service specification,provider-customer pair,cross-border route,and 12 monthly observations per year,excluding tests,demonstrations,and one-off transactions. By 2035-12-31,if the normalized content of enforceable licensing,liability,data-flow,and dispute-adjudication rules (covered scope,permissions,obligations,restrictions,enforcement procedure,and remedy outcome) is identical in each jurisdiction for those transactions,and for two consecutive years the cross-jurisdiction gap in successful service availability is no more than 5 percentage points,the maximum across transaction classes of the direct monetary switching-cost ratio is no more than 1. 2,and the maximum across transaction classes of the switching-time ratio is no more than 1. 2,where the ratio is each jurisdiction’s median of UTC hours from switch acceptance to successful completion,final failure,or abandonment,divided by that class’s lowest median,with 12 monthly medians required and no unverified year admitted,the judgment is falsified. Successful service means the same authorized transaction completes within a pre-registered common SLA for each transaction class;the common SLA compares only contract versions publicly available on the pre-registration date with identical service specification,plan/tier,region,availability measurement window,exclusions,and customer-obligation fields;use the strictest (shortest) commitment among those comparable contracts in participating jurisdictions,apply it uniformly,and freeze contract URLs,versions,and dates;if any jurisdiction lacks a complete comparable public commitment,that transaction class-year is unverified;availability is successful pre-registered authorized attempts within the common SLA divided by all pre-registered authorized attempts. Rule content uses a six-field normalized codebook on official versions (covered scope,permissions,obligations,restrictions,enforcement procedure,and remedy outcome;nulls,exceptions,and version numbers are retained as fixed metadata per record). Direct monetary switching cost per attempt is all fees plus migration hours through that attempt’s terminal state times a pre-registered common hourly rate;every pre-registered attempt-successful,failed,beyond SLA,or abandoned-enters cost and time aggregation. Convert fees at the official central-bank noon rate on the transaction start date to transaction-date USD,then deflate to constant January 2026 USD using the first-release value of the pre-registered official non-seasonally-adjusted U. S. CPI-U all-items,U. S. city average series CUUR0000SA0,with formula amount × CPI(2026-01)/CPI(transaction month),preserving the release-date vintage. Switching time per attempt is UTC hours from acceptance to successful completion,final failure,or abandonment;if no terminal state exists 30 days after the month ends,that year is unverified and the attempt may not be dropped or treated as successful. For cost and time separately,take the median of all pre-registered attempts by transaction class,jurisdiction,and month,then the median of the 12 monthly medians;divide each jurisdiction’s annual median by the lowest jurisdictional annual median for that class,and use the maximum ratio across all classes and jurisdictions as R_money or R_time. If any class lacks a common SLA,any month lacks complete terminal states,the exchange rate,or CPI,or any ratio’s lowest jurisdictional annual median is zero,that year is unverified:do not drop the class,impute a value,or divide by zero to pass the threshold. Absent measurement error,a single agreement or textual similarity is not enough.
en.judgment: From 2027-2035,states and large organizations are more likely first to rewrite cross-border availability of data,compute,and critical infrastructure through licensing,export controls,procurement,standards,localization,and mutual-recognition agreements,producing institutional zones with different interoperability,rather than automatically converging on one global rulebook;this is not a forecast of war or of one country’s inevitable victory.
en.leading_indicator: Each year,on the same pre-registered set of at least three materially different jurisdictions and the same transaction set (at least one cross-border data transfer,compute service,and critical-infrastructure service;one service specification,provider-customer pair,cross-border route,and 12 monthly observations per year for each class,excluding tests,demonstrations,and one-off transactions),record the six-field normalized codebook for all four rule classes (covered scope,permissions,obligations,restrictions,enforcement procedure,and remedy outcome;nulls,exceptions,and version numbers are retained as fixed metadata per record);set S=1 only when all four contents are identical across the three jurisdictions. Using the frozen common SLA,availability denominator,cost/time definitions,monthly-to-annual aggregation,and unverified rules above,compute the maximum cross-jurisdiction availability gap ΔA,the maximum cost ratio R_money,and the maximum time ratio R_time across classes and jurisdictions. Report a counter-signal matching the falsifier only when,for two consecutive years,S=1,ΔA ≤ 5 percentage points,R_money ≤ 1. 2,and R_time ≤ 1. 2;an unverified year is not a falsifier signal.
en.reasoning_chain: Critical infrastructure,data,and compute have geographic dependence and switching costs → states and large organizations gain bargaining chips with enforceable conditions → cross-border conflicts first enter licensing,procurement,standards,export,and localization procedures → mutual-recognition agreements lower some friction while preserving institutional differences → firms and residents face zoned availability and switching costs rather than one automatically unified global rulebook.

zh.audience: 受影响人口=十亿量级居民与跨境服务使用者(被数据流、基础设施依赖和制度区差异波及的影响面)
zh.falsifier: 预先固定至少三个制度差异显著法域和同一组跨境交易:跨境数据传输、算力服务、关键基础设施服务各至少一种;每种交易须有同一服务规格、提供者-客户对、跨境路线和每年 12 个月观测,排除测试、演示和一次性交易。 到 2035-12-31,若这些交易中每个法域的可执行许可、责任、数据流与争议裁决规则的规范化内容(适用范围、许可、义务、限制、执行程序、救济结果)完全相同,且连续两年成功服务可用率的法域间差异不超过 5 个百分点、各类别切换直接货币成本比值最大值不超过 1. 2、切换耗时比值最大值不超过 1. 2(耗时比值为各法域从受理到成功完成、最终失败或放弃终态的 UTC 小时年度中位数除以该类别最低值,要求连续 12 个月且不得有 unverified 年度),则本判断被证伪;成功服务定义为同一授权交易在各交易类别预先冻结的共同 SLA 内完成;共同 SLA 仅比较在预登记日公开可取得、且服务规格、计划/层级、区域、可用率测量窗口、排除项和客户义务字段完全相同的合同版本;取参与法域这些可比合同承诺的最严格(最短)值,所有法域统一使用并冻结合同 URL、版本和日期;任一法域没有完整可比公开承诺时,该交易类别该年度为 unverified;规则内容按官方版本的六字段规范化编码(适用范围、许可、义务、限制、执行程序、救济结果;空值、例外和版本号作为每条记录的固定元数据保留)。 每次切换的直接货币成本为该次尝试截至终态的全部费用加迁移工时乘预注册统一时薪;成功或失败、超 SLA 或放弃的每次预登记尝试都进入成本和耗时聚合。 费用按交易开始日官方央行日中汇率换算为交易日美元,再按预注册的美国官方 CPI-U 全部项目、城市平均、未季调序列 CUUR0000SA0 的首次发布值折算为 2026 年 1 月不变价美元,公式为金额乘 CPI(2026-01)/CPI(交易月),并保存发布日版本。 每次尝试耗时为从受理到成功完成、最终失败或放弃终态的 UTC 小时数;若截至该月末后 30 日仍无终态,该年度为 unverified,不得删掉该尝试或把它当作成功。 对成本和耗时分别按交易类别、法域和月份取所有预登记尝试的中位数,再取连续 12 个月月中位数的中位数;每个法域的年度中位数除以该类别最低法域年度中位数,并以所有类别和法域中的最大比值作为 R_money 或 R_time。 任一类别无共同 SLA、任一月份缺少完整终态、汇率或 CPI,或任一比值的最低法域年度中位数为 0,则该年度为 unverified,不得剔除类别、补值或以零除来通过阈值;若不是测量口径造成,则不以单一协议或文本相似作为证伪。
zh.judgment: 2027-2035 年,国家与大型组织更可能先通过许可、出口管制、采购、标准、本地化与互认协议来重写数据、算力和关键基础设施的跨境可用边界,形成多个互操作程度不同的制度区,而不是自动收敛为一套全球统一规则;这不是对战争或某国必胜的预测。
zh.leading_indicator: 每年在同一组预先登记的至少三个制度差异显著法域和同一组交易上(跨境数据传输、算力服务、关键基础设施服务各至少一种;同一服务规格、提供者-客户对、跨境路线、每年 12 个月观测,排除测试、演示和一次性交易),逐项记录四类规则的六字段规范化内容(适用范围、许可、义务、限制、执行程序、救济结果;空值、例外和版本号作为每条记录的固定元数据保留);记为 S=1 仅当四类内容在三个法域均完全相同。 按证伪条件冻结的共同 SLA、可用率分母、成本/耗时定义、月度-年度聚合和 unverified 规则,计算最大法域间可用率差异 ΔA、各类别/法域中的最大成本比 R_money 与最大耗时比 R_time。 仅当连续两年 S=1、ΔA ≤ 5 个百分点、R_money ≤ 1. 2、R_time ≤ 1. 2 时,才报告与证伪条件相同的反向信号;任一年度为 unverified 都不算证伪信号。
zh.reasoning_chain: 关键基础设施与数据、算力存在地理依赖和替代成本 → 国家与大型组织获得可施加条件的议价筹码 → 跨境冲突先进入许可、采购、标准、出口和本地化程序 → 互认协议降低部分摩擦但保留制度差异 → 企业和居民面对的是分区可用能力与切换成本,而非一套自动统一的全球规则。

en.audience: constructed tens-of-millions-scale reach across junior knowledge workers,applicants,and professional trainees
en.falsifier: By 2032,across at least five generation-intensive occupations,junior-seat share does not decline before total occupational headcount;or it declines first but verifiable apprenticeship,simulation,rotation,or supervised-fieldwork capacity expands enough to preserve the pre-adoption replenishment rate of professionals. Junior seats falling at the same time as or after total occupational contraction also falsifies the card.
en.judgment: From 2027 to 2034,in generation-intensive occupations junior production seats and routine hours shrink relatively before total occupational headcount,making supervised practice a skill-formation bottleneck.
en.leading_indicator: junior-to-senior hiring ratio,entry-task mix,apprenticeship places,supervised hours,time to promotion,and controlled performance of external candidates;annually.
en.reasoning_chain: Junior production is easiest to verify and automate → seniors sustain output with fewer junior hours → entrants lose the carrier for real-task practice → apprenticeship,simulation,and supervised fieldwork become scarcer.

zh.audience: 初级知识工作者、求职者与专业训练者为构造式千万量级
zh.falsifier: 到 2032 年,在至少五个生成密集职业中,初级席位占比没有先于职业总人数下降;或虽先下降,但可验证的学徒、模拟、轮岗或受监督实战容量同步扩张到足以维持采用前的专业者补充率。 初级席位与职业总人数同步下降或晚于整体收缩,也触发本卡证伪。
zh.judgment: 2027-2034 年,在生成密集职业中,初级产出席位和例行工时的相对收缩先于职业总人数下降,受监督实战成为技能形成瓶颈。
zh.leading_indicator: 初级/资深招聘比、入职任务结构、学徒席位、监督时数、晋升周期、外部候选人的受控表现;每年。
zh.reasoning_chain: 初级产出最易验证并自动化 → 资深者用更少初级工时维持产量 → 新人失去以真实任务练习的载体 → 学徒、模拟与受监督实战的稀缺上升。

en.audience: The affected population is a constructed tens-of-millions impact reach of care recipients,family members,and care workers. The actual repeated actors are adults who provide hands-on care or care coordination at least weekly;the countable part of them-"providing unpaid care to an elderly,ill or disabled family member or friend" each week-has,under the definition frozen on 2026-10-10,only two qualifying weekly measures,the US and the UK,together about 31 million,which is tens-of-millions-scale (see M2 in §3 of the verdict on social actions that do not presuppose AI;the EU,China,Japan and India have no qualifying figures and are not counted). This does not support hundred-million-scale diffusion (corrected 2026-10-10:this field previously said "available comparable evidence supports only subgroups at no more than the million-scale",which that count contradicts).
en.falsifier: By 2033,in at least four comparable demographic and care systems,family-care time,formal-care spending,and coordination roles have not moved toward formal/coordination carriers;or any movement is fully explained by a short-term business cycle rather than demographic structure and household size.
en.judgment: From 2027-2035,ageing and smaller households will move part of care from invisible family obligations toward formal services,insurance/public payment,and cross-institution coordination;this will not mean that hands-on family care exits.
en.leading_indicator: Daily/weekly frequency of informal care,care leave and labour-force exit,long-term-care insurance/public-care spending,home-care hours,coordination roles,and waiting time;annually.
en.reasoning_chain: Persistent elder-care demand → less available family time → scheduling,leave,and continuity gaps in unpaid care → insurance/public services and coordination roles carry some actions → families retain authorisation,companionship,and exception decisions.

zh.audience: 受影响人群为照护对象、家庭成员和照护劳动者,构造式千万量级影响面;实际重复执行者是每周至少一次完成亲手照护或照护协调的成年人;其中可数的一部分--「每周为一位高龄、患病或失能的家人或亲友提供无酬照料」--按 2026-10-10 冻结口径只有美、英两个合格周口径,合计约 3,100 万,属千万量级(见不以 AI 为前提的社会动作判定 §3 的 M2;欧盟、中国、日本、印度没有合格数字,未计入),不能据此声称亿级普及(2026-10-10 更正:此前写「现有可比证据只支持百万量级以内的职业/调查子群」,与该计数矛盾)。
zh.falsifier: 到 2033 年,在至少四个具有可比人口与照护统计的制度中,家庭照护时间、正式照护支出和协调岗位均没有向正式/协调载体移动;或者移动完全由短期经济周期解释,而非人口结构与家庭规模变化。
zh.judgment: 2027-2035 年,老龄化与家庭缩小会使部分照护从家庭内部的隐性义务转向正式服务、保险/公共支付和跨机构协调;但这不等于家庭亲手照护退出。
zh.leading_indicator: 非正式照护者的日/周频率、照护请假与退出劳动市场比例、长期护理保险/公共照护支出、居家服务工时、照护协调岗位与等待时间;每年。
zh.reasoning_chain: 老年照护需求持续 → 可用家庭时间相对减少 → 无偿照护出现排班、请假和连续性缺口 → 保险/公共服务与协调岗位承接部分动作 → 家庭仍保留授权、陪伴和异常决策。

en.audience: Direct actors are a million-scale-or-smaller population of high-liability professionals,compliance and safety staff,service providers,and public institutions;affected customers,workers,and residents are a tens-of-millions impact reach. it does not give people without liability standing broad access to irreversible decision rights. The necessary frequency boundary remains unverified:no cross-system deduplicated weekly-actor denominator is available,so the million-scale figure is an occupational/institutional upper bound,not a society-scale weekly count.
en.falsifier: By 2033,in at least three consequential institutional settings,large numbers of continuously used AI agents operate outside the liability of a person,organisation,or public institution without traceable authority,revocation,logs,appeals,and compensation arrangements;or these interfaces become widespread without changing procurement,incident handling,or practical limits on agent authority. One-off demonstrations,no-liability chat,and pilots do not falsify the judgment.
en.judgment: From 2027-2035,human-AI relationships in consequential settings are more likely to stabilise first as tiered agency attached to the liability of a person,organisation,or public institution. Authorisation,revocation,logs,and appeals become visible interfaces before AI is broadly recognised as an independent liable subject.
en.leading_indicator: Share of consequential-AI contracts with authority,revocation,and overreach clauses;sustained deployments with human takeover and appeal paths;liability attribution and insurance exclusions after agent incidents;cross-party revocation completion time;observe quarterly or annually.
en.reasoning_chain: Society needs durable delegation → institutions split authority,revocation,oversight,evidence,and liability → existing liable parties carry digital agents first → AI expands execution inside controlled boundaries → the human-AI relationship first becomes a rights-and-liability relationship.

zh.audience: 直接行动者是百万量级以内的高责任岗位、合规/安全人员、服务提供者和公共机构;受影响的客户、劳动者与居民为千万量级影响面。 必要频次边界仍未验证:当前没有跨制度去重的每周行动者分母,因此百万量级只是职业/制度层上限,不是社会级周频人数。
zh.falsifier: 到 2033 年,在至少三个高责任制度环境中,大量持续使用的 AI 代理已经能够脱离个人、组织或公共机构的责任承接,且不需要可追踪授权、撤回、日志、申诉和赔付安排;或者这些接口普遍存在,却没有改变采购、事故处置和代理权限的实际边界。 一次性演示、无责任聊天和试点不算推翻。
zh.judgment: 2027-2035 年,高责任场景中的人与 AI 关系更可能先稳定为挂靠在个人、组织或公共机构责任之下的分级代理;授权、撤回、日志和申诉会先成为可见接口,而不是出现被广泛承认为独立责任主体的 AI。
zh.leading_indicator: 高责任 AI 合同中授权/撤回/越权条款的比例;有人工接管和申诉路径的持续部署数;代理事故的责任归属与保险除外条款;跨主体撤回的完成时间;按季度或年度观察。
zh.reasoning_chain: 社会需要持续委托 → 制度把授权、撤回、监督、证据和责任拆开 → 已有责任主体先承接数字代理 → AI 在受控边界内扩大执行范围 → 人与 AI 的关系先成为权限与责任关系。

en.audience: Affected population = data subjects,consumers,and people touched by automated decisions,a billion-scale impact reach (not evidence of billion-scale repeated action);actual repeated actors/behaviour denominator = organizational staff who configure data permissions,model-output licences,or agent-liability procedures at least weekly
en.falsifier: By 2035-12-31,in at least three materially different legal systems,most high-consequence model incidents are directly adjudicated through a uniform model-provider/model-subject liability rule and compensation and correction no longer rely mainly on deploying organizations,contracts,insurance,or human liability carriers;the result counts as a falsification only when public-reporting coverage reaches 80% and indeterminate cases are no more than 20% in each jurisdiction,otherwise it remains unverified. A high-consequence incident is included only when a model output or action directly or materially recommends an action affecting physical safety,health care,employment,credit/benefits,legal rights,or property transfer and produces actual harm or a formal claim within 90 days;records in one jurisdiction for one deployment,claim,and 24-hour window merge by case ID,or without one only when deployment organization,date,domain,and claim all match. Estimate coverage from public reports,mandatory regulatory/insurance records,and independent sampling with a fixed three-source main-effects log-linear capture-recapture model;if linkable overlap cannot be built or the model does not converge,80% cannot be claimed. Absent sampling or reporting failure,the judgment is falsified.
en.judgment: From 2027-2035,rights around data access,training provenance,model-output licensing,and agent-incident liability are more likely to become layered,revocable,and scenario-specific than to become one universal “data ownership” or an independent AI liability subject;compensation and correction in consequential settings will remain primarily attached to recoverable organizations,insurance,and contractual networks.
en.leading_indicator: Every six months,in at least three pre-registered materially different jurisdictions,register the population of high-consequence model incidents satisfying the inclusion rule above (domestic and cross-border deployments;one fixed task type and time window). Link the three sources by case ID or the four matching keys and estimate the population with the fixed three-source main-effects log-linear capture-recapture model;if the model does not converge or overlap cannot be built,retain unverified. For each incident record the liability rule,whether compensation and correction still relied on deploying organizations,contracts,insurance,or human carriers,and indeterminate;report the counter-signal matching the falsifier only when,in all four half-year periods across every jurisdiction,coverage is at least 80%,indeterminate cases are no more than 20%,and R = incidents directly adjudicated by the uniform model rule without those carriers / all determinate incidents is R > 0. 5 in all three jurisdictions.
en.reasoning_chain: Data and model outputs are replicable but provenance,privacy,training contribution,and real-world consequences are not fully replicable → access,use,returns,revocation,and proof split into different rights → consequential settings need recoverable organizations,insurance,audits,and human review → cross-system agent incidents expose jurisdiction and compensation conflicts → institutions extend layered permission and liability carriers rather than granting models independent legal personality.

zh.audience: 受影响人口=十亿量级数据主体、消费者与被自动化决策波及的人(影响面,不能据此声称十亿量级实际重复行动)
zh.falsifier: 到 2035-12-31,在至少三个制度差异显著的法域中,绝大多数高责任模型事故都由统一的模型供应商/模型主体责任规则直接裁判,且赔偿与纠错不再主要依赖部署组织、合同、保险或人工责任承载;只有当每个法域公开报告覆盖率达到 80% 且无法判定项不超过 20% 时,才把该结果判为证伪,否则维持 unverified。 高责任事故的纳入条件固定为:模型输出或动作直接或实质性建议影响身体安全、医疗、就业、信贷/福利、法律权利或财产转移,并在 90 日内产生实际损害或正式索赔;同一法域、同一部署、同一主张、时间相差不超过 24 小时的记录以案件 ID 合并,缺少案件 ID 时须至少匹配部署组织、日期、领域和主张四项才合并。 覆盖率用公开报告、强制监管/保险记录与独立抽样三类来源,按固定的三源主效应 log-linear 捕获-再捕获模型估计;三源不能建立可链接重叠或模型不收敛时不得宣称达到 80%。 若该结果不是由样本定义或报告缺失造成,则本判断被证伪。
zh.judgment: 2027-2035 年,数据访问、训练来源、模型产出许可与代理事故责任更可能形成分层、可撤回、按场景分配的权利组合,而不是形成一个统一的“数据所有权”或独立的 AI 责任主体;高责任场景的赔偿与纠错仍优先挂在可追偿的组织、保险与合同网络上。
zh.leading_indicator: 每半年在预先固定的至少三个制度差异显著法域登记符合上述纳入条件的高责任模型事故母集合(包括境内与跨境部署;固定同一任务类型和时间窗)。 三类来源用案件 ID 或四项匹配键链接,按固定的三源主效应 log-linear 捕获-再捕获模型估计母集合;模型不收敛或无法建立重叠时维持 unverified。 对每起事故记录责任裁判规则、赔偿与纠错是否仍依赖部署组织/合同/保险/人工责任承载和无法判定项;仅当四个连续半年期的每个法域覆盖率均达到 80%、无法判定项不超过 20%,且 R = 直接由统一模型规则裁判且不依赖上述承载的事故数 / 可判定事故总数 在三个法域均 R > 0. 5 时,才报告与证伪条件相同的反向信号。
zh.reasoning_chain: 数据与模型产出可复制但来源、隐私、训练贡献和现实后果不可完全复制 → 访问、使用、收益、撤回和举证被拆成不同权利 → 高责任场景需要可追偿组织、保险、审计和人工复核 → 跨制度代理事故暴露管辖与赔偿冲突 → 制度先扩展分层许可与责任承载,而不是授予模型独立主体资格。

en.audience: The impact reach is the people in recipient countries who depend on aid programmes,a constructed hundred-millions-scale reach (head counts not verified this round);they do not vote in the donor countries and are not counted in any denominator;this card judges the budget behaviour of four countries,not an individual action,and the direct deciders are the four countries' governments and parliaments. it judges whether a line of foreign spending gives way to defence.
en.falsifier: Any one of the following falsifies this card:(1) the latest OECD data for 2028 available before 2029-12-31 (grant-equivalent measure) show that the ODA share of gross national income of any of the UK,France or Germany is not below its 2023 level;(2) the UK's 2028 ODA share is above 0. 35%;(3) Italy's 2028 ODA share is above 0. 35%;(4) data from the same NATO edition show that the 2028 core defence share of any of the UK,France or Germany is not above its 2023 level - if defence also falls back,the mechanism “aid gives way to defence” does not hold,even if aid stays low. The 2023 baseline is the revised 2023 value in the latest edition at the time of the check;if the revision exceeds 0. 05 percentage points,record the revision and judge against the new baseline.
en.judgment: Checked against 2028 data published in 2029,official development assistance (ODA) as a share of gross national income in the UK,France and Germany is in each case still below its own 2023 level (0. 58%,0. 50%,0. 79%),and core defence spending as a share of GDP is in each case still above its own 2023 level (NATO 2026 edition:2. 22%,1. 88%,1. 60%);the ODA shares of the UK and Italy are both no higher than 0. 35% - the budget with no domestic periodic recipients is squeezed out first,and it does not swing back within the window.
en.leading_indicator: ODA and defence appropriations in each country's annual budget;the OECD's preliminary ODA data,released each April;NATO's annual defence expenditure report and the annual paths submitted by each country;the share of ODA spent on refugees inside donor countries;whether the UK's two fiscal tests for returning to 0. 7% are met;annually.
en.reasoning_chain: At the Hague summit in June 2025,NATO agreed on core defence of at least 3. 5%,and 5% in total,by 2035,with paths submitted every year and a review in 2029 → the core defence shares of all four countries rose from 2023 to 2026 → raising taxes and cutting domestic benefit programmes both meet defenders → aid has no one in the donor country who draws it on a recurring basis (formerly the L10 veto direction:within reach;now carried by no lens in L1-L9) → the UK cut twice (2020:0. 7% → 0. 5%;2025:announced 0. 5% → 0. 3%,explicitly for defence),the preliminary 2025 data for France and Germany are already below 2023,and the DAC total fell to 0. 26% in 2025 → no domestic defender pulls it back,and the 2028 data are still below 2023 (carried by no lens:L10 says nothing about timing or about whether a cut swings back;this step rests only on the 2020-2025 budget record). Italy's ODA was low to begin with (0. 27% in 2023) and rose slightly in 2025;this card judges only that it does not exceed 0. 35%.

zh.audience: 影响面是受援国中依赖援助项目的人,构造式亿量级(本轮未核实人数),他们不在援助国投票,不计入任何分母;本卡判断的是四国的预算行为,不是个人动作,直接决定者是四国政府与议会。
zh.falsifier: 以下任一条成立,即证伪本卡:(1) 2029-12-31 前可得的最新 OECD 2028 年数据(赠款等值口径)显示英、法、德任一国 ODA 占国民总收入比重不低于其 2023 年水平;(2) 英国 2028 年 ODA 占比高于 0. 35%;(3) 意大利 2028 年 ODA 占比高于 0. 35%;(4) 北约同一版次的数据显示英、法、德任一国 2028 年核心国防占比不高于其 2023 年水平--国防若也回落,「」的机制不成立,即使援外仍低。 2023 年基准取复核时最新版次对 2023 年的修订值;修订超过 0. 05 个百分点时,记录修订并按新基准判。
zh.judgment: 按 2029 年发布的 2028 年数据复核,英、法、德三国的官方发展援助(ODA)占国民总收入比重都仍低于各自 2023 年水平(0. 58%、0. 50%、0. 79%),核心国防开支占 GDP 比重都仍高于各自 2023 年水平(北约 2026 年版:2. 22%、1. 88%、1. 60%);英国与意大利的 ODA 占比都不高于 0. 35%--没有国内按期领取者的预算先被挤出,而且在窗口内不回摆。
zh.leading_indicator: 各国年度预算中的 ODA 拨款与国防拨款;OECD 每年 4 月发布的初步 ODA 数据;北约每年的国防开支报告与各国提交的年度路径;援助国境内难民开支占 ODA 的比重;英国恢复 0. 7% 的两项财政测试是否满足;每年。
zh.reasoning_chain: 北约 2025 年 6 月海牙峰会同意到 2035 年核心国防至少 3. 5%、合计 5%,每年提交路径,2029 年复核 → 四国核心国防占比 2023-2026 年全部上升 → 加税与削减国内领取项目都会遇到捍卫者 → 援外在援助国国内没有按周期领取的人(原 L10 否决向:可达;现为 L1-L9 中无承载)→ 英国两次削减(2020 年 0. 7%→0. 5%;2025 年宣布 0. 5%→0. 3%,明言用于国防),法、德 2025 年初步数据已低于 2023 年,DAC 合计 2025 年降到 0. 26% → 没有国内捍卫者把它拉回,到 2028 年数据仍低于 2023 年(无承载:L10 不判时机,也不判削减后会不会回摆;这一步只靠 2020-2025 年的预算记录)。 意大利的 ODA 本就低(2023 年 0. 27%),2025 年略升,本卡只判它不超过 0. 35%。

en.audience: a constructed million-scale set of semiconductor procurement,process,equipment,supply-chain,policy,and infrastructure professionals performs the work
en.falsifier: By 2030,across at least three advanced-semiconductor clusters or ten major manufacturing,materials,or equipment firms,resilience spending still mainly increases raw or finished inventory,while pre-qualification of alternatives,dual process qualification,portable recipes,parts/service redundancy,and cross-site transfer time show no observable growth. Merely increasing nominal supplier count without qualification does not count as a hit.
en.judgment: From 2026 to 2032,resilience investment for advanced semiconductors shifts from larger raw-material and finished-goods inventories toward pre-qualified alternate refining,electronic-grade conversion,tool service,recipes,and process-transfer paths.
en.leading_indicator: share of dual-qualified materials,alternate-source qualification duration,portable recipe/mask coverage,parts and service redundancy,cross-site failover exercises,and inventory-to-qualification budget ratio;annually.
en.reasoning_chain: compute expansion raises demand for advanced-semiconductor capacity and resilience → some critical materials are by-products of other ore-processing systems,so incremental supply does not respond only to their own price → electronic-grade purity,recipes,tools,and customer approval turn chemically identical material into a process-specific input → inventory buffers disruption but cannot replace an unqualified conversion node → one firm rarely funds idle backup paths alone,so large buyers,public support,or cluster-level closed loops must coordinate them → firms move marginal resilience spending toward advance qualification and exercised switching.

zh.falsifier: 到 2030 年,在至少三个先进半导体制造集群或十家主要制造/材料/设备企业中,韧性投入仍主要增加原料或成品库存;替代来源的预验证、双重工艺资格、可转移配方、备件/服务冗余与跨场址切换时间均无可观察增长。 只增加名义供应商数量而没有验证,不算命中。

zh.reasoning_chain: 算力扩张推动先进半导体产能与韧性需求 → 部分关键材料是其他矿业加工的副产品,增量供给不只响应本品价格 → 电子级纯度、配方、设备与客户批准把同名材料变成工艺专用品 → 库存只能缓冲中断,不能替代未验证转化节点 → 单一企业难为闲置备用链独自买单,需由大买方、公共支持或集群闭环协调 → 企业把边际韧性预算移向替代路径的提前验证与实际切换。

en.audience: direct decision makers are a million-scale-or-smaller set of fab,materials,utility,government,and community professionals
en.falsifier: By 2031,across at least ten new or substantially expanded advanced fabs,siting,subsidies,and utility contracts remain explained mainly by land,tax,and average water/power prices;power quality,withdrawal/discharge rights,reuse,drought/flood adaptation,and dedicated facilities neither change rankings nor create material contracts or capital spending.
en.judgment: From 2026 to 2033,advanced-fab siting and public support increasingly price firm power,power quality,inlet-water quality,reuse,discharge,and climate adaptation as a bundle rather than comparing land,tax,and average utility prices separately.
en.leading_indicator: project capital spending on dedicated water/power systems,withdrawal per wafer and recovery rate,power-quality clauses,withdrawal/discharge permitting time,climate-adaptation conditions,and projects exited or delayed for utility reasons;semi-annually.
en.reasoning_chain: advanced processes jointly require firm power,ultrapure water,gases and chemicals,and discharge capacity → failure of one utility makes cheap land unusable → climate risk increases variance in public systems → dedicated treatment,reuse,reserves,and power quality enter total siting cost and subsidy conditions.

zh.audience: 直接决策者为十万至百万量级的晶圆厂、材料、公用事业、政府与社区专业者
zh.falsifier: 到 2031 年,在至少十个新建或大扩建先进晶圆厂项目中,选址、补贴和公用事业合同仍主要由土地、税率与平均电/水价格解释;电能质量、取排水权、回用率、干旱/洪水适应和专用设施既不改变排名,也不形成实质合同或资本开支。
zh.judgment: 2026-2033 年,先进晶圆厂选址与公共支持越来越按稳定电力、电能质量、进水水质、水回用、排放与气候适应的组合能力定价,而不是分别比较土地、税率和平均公用事业价格。

zh.reasoning_chain: 先进工艺同时需要稳定电力、超纯水、气体化学品与排放能力 → 任一公用工程不合格都会把廉价土地变成不可用场址 → 气候风险提高公共系统供给方差 → 专用处理、回用、储备与电力质量进入选址总成本和补贴条件。

en.audience: affected population = constructed hundred-millions-scale knowledge workers,operations staff,and managers;actual repeated actors / behaviour denominator = deduplicated organizations or accountable owners completing the production “machine-default execution - human exception handling - accountable boundary setting” loop at least weekly at T,not all workers reached;this card has no citable hundred-million-scale loop denominator,so the hundred-million figure is impact reach only

The card fails whether the remainder is end-to-end staffless execution or deployment broadly stalls in demonstrations and failures.
en.judgment: From 2026 to 2031,organizations adopting generation and tool use first split work into machine-default execution,human exception handling,and accountable boundary setting rather than broadly becoming staffless.

en.reasoning_chain: Generation and tool use mature first → bounded reviewable tasks enter workflows first → exceptions and liability still need a principal → the minimum production unit becomes one accountable person supervising multiple machine executions.

zh.audience: 受影响人口为构造式亿量级知识工作者、运营人员与管理者;实际重复执行者/行为分母是 T 时每周至少一次在生产环境完成“机器默认执行-人类处理例外-责任人设定边界”闭环的去重组织/责任人,而不是所有被影响劳动者;本卡没有可引用的亿级闭环执行分母,因此亿只能写影响面
zh.falsifier: 到 2031 年,在至少三个大型知识工作行业,持续十二个月的生产级 AI 部署中,采用“机器默认执行/人类处理例外/责任人设定边界”工作单元的比例仍不足一半;无论另一半由端到端无人执行占据,还是部署普遍停在演示与失败阶段,均触发本卡证伪。
zh.judgment: 2026-2031 年,采用生成与工具调用的组织先把工作拆成机器默认执行、人类处理例外、责任人设定边界,而不是普遍形成无人组织。
