zh.reasoning_chain: 生成和工具调用先成熟 → 边界清楚、可复核任务先被嵌入 → 例外与责任仍需主体 → 最小生产单元先变成人类责任人监督多次机器执行。

en.audience: The impact reach includes the 65+ populations of the G7,China,India and other countries,a constructed hundred-millions-scale reach that is not counted in the denominator;the actual repeated actors are people aged 65+ who worked at least one hour for pay in the reference week - under the frozen measure the qualifying sum lies between about 10. 29 million and 51. 64 million,tens-of-millions-scale;Japan's 65-69 group is above half on the published figure,unverified after family workers are subtracted. it lets people who are already working delay their exit.
en.falsifier: Any one of the following falsifies the corresponding part of this card:(1) in the latest annual data available before 2030-10-10,the sum for the same seven countries and the same series is ≥ 100 million (overturns “still below 100 million”);(2) the sum for the same fixed panel is below the about 51. 64 million registered on this card (overturns “rises”);(3) in any year within the window,the employment rate of Japan's 65-69 group on the published figure is below 50% (overturns the “stays at 50% or above” item of the forward claim;this published figure includes family workers and does not carry the current D-tier verdict);(4) a new component appears,with a reference period between 2023-01-01 and 2026-10-10,that qualifies under the frozen rules (for example a count of employed people aged 65+ for China or the EU) and brings the sum of qualifying components to ≥ 100 million (overturns the C verdict of the “Current-scale review” - this is an overturn by measurement coverage,not behavioural expansion,and must be recorded separately from (1)). If any country's definition changes,it is recorded only as a definitional change and may not count as a hit.
en.judgment: As of 2026-10-10,“aged 65 or over and working at least one hour for pay in the reference week” reaches only the D tier (segment diffusion) under the definitions frozen in advance:the components of the seven countries that can be counted sum to about 51. 64 million before unpaid family helpers are subtracted,which is an upper bound on the qualifying sum;the subtraction the freeze requires was not carried out this round,and the lower bound derived from Japan and South Korea is about 10. 29 million,so the qualifying sum lies in the tens of millions,short of hundred-million weekly reach (the EU,China,Brazil,Indonesia and Mexico count as 0 under the rules);through 2030-10-10,the sum for the same seven-country panel rises but stays below 100 million,and the employment rate of Japan's 65-69 group,on the published figure,stays at 50% or above.
en.leading_indicator: The US BLS monthly series of employed people aged 65+ (LNU02000097);the employment rate of 65-69-year-olds in the Labour Force Survey of Japan's Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications;the employment rate of 66-year-olds in the UK while the State Pension age rises to 67;whether China's National Bureau of Statistics starts publishing counts of employed people aged 65+;Eurostat's count of employed people aged 65+;annually.
en.reasoning_chain: The fiscal squeeze leads countries to raise the age at which the public pension can be drawn,and this cut falls on cohorts not yet drawing (an upstream condition,carried by no lens) → income breaks off after the old pension age,and some people keep working every week (carried by no lens) → counted once under the frozen measure:about 51. 64 million across seven countries before unpaid family helpers are subtracted,and a lower bound of about 10. 29 million derived from Japan and South Korea (a constraint fails;the D-tier sum route holds on the lower bound) → legislated increases keep taking effect in 2026-2030,and the 65+ population keeps growing → the fixed-panel sum rises,but going from about 52 million to 100 million would need almost a doubling,which cannot happen in four years → within the window it stays at the D tier.

zh.audience: 影响面包括七国集团与中、印等国的 65 岁以上人口,构造式亿量级,不计入分母;实际重复执行者为参照周内为报酬至少工作 1 小时的 65 岁以上者,按冻结口径的合格合计在约 1,029 万至 5,164 万之间,属千万量级;日本 65-69 岁组按公布值过半,扣除家族从业者后未核实。
zh.falsifier: 以下任一条成立,即证伪本卡对应的那一部分:(1) 2030-10-10 前可得的最新年度数据中,同一七国、同一序列的合计 ≥ 1 亿(推翻「仍低于 1 亿」);(2) 同一固定面板的合计低于本卡登记的约 5,164 万(推翻「上升」);(3) 窗口内任一年度,日本 65-69 岁组按公布值的就业率低于 50%(推翻前瞻里「保持在 50% 以上」一项;这个公布值含家族从业者,不承担现时的 D 档判定);(4) 出现参照期在 2023-01-01 至 2026-10-10 之间、按冻结规则合格的新分量(例如中国或欧盟的 65 岁以上就业人数),使合格分量之和 ≥ 1 亿(推翻「现时规模复核」的 C 判定--这是测量覆盖的推翻,不是行为扩张,须与 (1) 分开记录)。 任一国口径改变时,只登记为口径变化,不据此判命中。
zh.judgment: 截至 2026-10-10,「年满 65 岁、在参照周内为报酬至少工作 1 小时」按事先冻结的口径只到 D 档(分众普及):可计入的七国分量在扣除无酬家庭帮工之前合计约 5,164 万,这是合格合计的上界;冻结要求的扣除本轮没有执行,按日本、韩国两国推出的下界约 1,029 万,合格合计落在千万级,达不到亿级周频(欧盟、中国、巴西、印尼、墨西哥按规则记 0);到 2030-10-10,同一七国面板的合计上升但仍低于 1 亿,日本 65-69 岁组按公布值的就业率保持在 50% 以上。
zh.leading_indicator: 美国 BLS 65 岁以上就业人数月度序列(LNU02000097);日本总务省劳动力调查的 65-69 岁就业率;英国 66 岁人群在国家养老金领取年龄升到 67 岁期间的就业率;中国国家统计局是否开始公布 65 岁以上就业人数;欧盟统计局 65 岁以上就业人数;每年。
zh.reasoning_chain: 财政挤压让各国推后公共养老金的领取年龄,这一刀落在尚未领取的队列身上(an upstream condition,无承载)→ 收入在旧领取年龄之后断档,一部分人继续每周工作(无承载)→ 按冻结口径数一次:七国未扣除无酬家庭帮工的合计约 5,164 万,按日本、韩国推出的下界约 1,029 万(一道约束不过,D 档合计路径按下界成立)→ 已立法的推后在 2026-2030 年继续生效,65 岁以上人口继续增长 → 固定面板合计上升,但从约 5,200 万到 1 亿需要几乎翻倍,四年内到不了 → 窗口内停在 D 档。

en.audience: Affected population = residents,commuters,local governments,and policyholders in highly exposed places,a billion-scale impact reach;actual repeated actors/behaviour denominator = not applicable,because this card judges institutional risk transmission rather than repeated action
en.falsifier: In at least 20 pre-registered high-exposure places,if for five consecutive years disaster-related premiums/deductibles and road or public-transit disruption days are no higher than the 2024-2026 baseline,low-income housing burden and discretionary-consumption loss do not widen relative to high-income groups,and adaptation spending reaches its registered target,the direction that risk first widens inequality is refuted;missing comparable group or loss data is indeterminate.
en.judgment: From 2027 to 2035,households and local governments in highly exposed places are more likely to bear environmental shocks first through insurance gaps,inadequate adaptation investment,and travel disruption,with greater risks to discretionary consumption and housing stability among low-income households and fiscally weak places;particular disasters and magnitudes are not certain forecasts.
en.leading_indicator: Extreme-weather losses,insurance refusal/premiums,outages and road disruption,local adaptation capital spending,food prices,migration,and housing burden;quarterly/annually.
en.reasoning_chain: Extreme weather and infrastructure fragility create losses → premiums,deductibles,and interruptions rise → low-income households have less adaptation capital and less ability to move → local budgets allocate among repair,public safety,and long-term adaptation → risk travels through food,housing,income,and migration,widening inequality;timely adaptation can buffer it,so the path is not inevitable.

zh.audience: 受影响人口=高暴露地区居民、通勤者、地方政府与保险持有人,十亿量级影响面;实际重复执行者/行为分母=不适用,本卡判断制度风险传导而非重复动作
zh.falsifier: 在预注册的至少 20 个高暴露地区,若连续五年灾害相关保费/免赔额、道路或公共交通中断天数均不高于 2024-2026 基线,且低收入家庭住房负担与非必要消费损失相对高收入组不扩大,同时适应投资达到登记目标,则“风险先扩大不平等”的方向被证伪;没有可比分组或损失数据时不可判定。
zh.judgment: 2027-2035 年,高气候暴露地区的家庭与地方政府更可能先通过保险缺口、适应投资不足和出行中断承受环境冲击,低收入家庭与财政薄弱地区的可支配消费和居住稳定性风险更高;具体灾害与规模仍不是确定预测。
zh.leading_indicator: 极端天气损失、保险拒保/保费、停电与道路中断、地方适应资本支出、食品价格、迁移与住房负担;季度/年度。
zh.reasoning_chain: 极端天气与基础设施脆弱性造成损失 → 保费、免赔额和停运上升 → 低收入家庭缺乏适应资本且更难搬迁 → 地方财政需在修复、公共安全与长期适应间分配 → 风险通过食品、住房、收入和迁移扩大不平等;及时适应可缓冲,故不是单向必然。

en.audience: Affected population = middle-income adults and cultural venues/households in high-income cities,a billion-scale impact reach;actual repeated actors/behaviour denominator = deduplicated adults buying or attending a cultural-entertainment activity at least monthly at T,for which no cross-country common denominator exists,so billion-scale diffusion is not claimed
en.falsifier: In at least 12 pre-registered high-income cities,if relative to the 2024-2026 baseline the median frequency of offline cultural participation among middle-income adults rises at least 10% for three consecutive years,while time-use data show less fragmentation,ticket burden does not rise,and streaming entertainment time does not increase,the constraint-and-partial-substitution direction is refuted;missing common time-use data is indeterminate.
en.judgment: From 2027 to 2032,in high-income cities with comparable data,middle-income adults’ offline cultural participation will remain constrained by fragmented leisure,ticket prices,and access time,while pausable streaming/short-form video substitutes for some everyday entertainment slots;this is directional,not a claim about a platform or national winner.
en.leading_indicator: Time-use surveys,cultural ticket-price/income ratio,venue access time,monthly repeat participation,and streaming hours;annually.
en.reasoning_chain: Work and care fragment leisure → prices,distance,and queues raise fixed costs of offline participation → pausable media lowers coordination costs and occupies small slots → live culture remains supported by identity,sociability,and place → the likely result is substitution and stratification by slot,not one medium replacing culture.

zh.audience: 受影响人口=高收入城市中等收入成年人及文化场馆、家庭,亿量级影响面;实际重复执行者/行为分母=在 T 时每月至少一次购买或参加文化娱乐活动的去重成年人,当前没有跨国统一分母,不能声称亿级普及
zh.falsifier: 在预注册的至少 12 个高收入城市中,若相对 2024-2026 基线,线下文化参与频率在中等收入成年人中位数连续三年上升至少 10%,且时间使用显示碎片化下降、票价负担不升、流媒体娱乐时长不增加,则“约束与部分替代”方向被证伪;缺失统一时间使用数据时记为不可判定。
zh.judgment: 2027-2032 年,在有可比数据的高收入城市,中等收入成年人线下文化参与会继续受碎片化闲暇、票价与到达时间约束,而可暂停的流媒体/短视频会替代部分日常娱乐时段;这只是方向判断,不指定平台或国家赢家。
zh.leading_indicator: 时间使用调查、文化票价/收入比、场馆到达时间、月度重复参与率与流媒体时长;每年。
zh.reasoning_chain: 工作与照护切碎闲暇 → 票价、距离和排队放大线下参与的固定成本 → 可暂停媒介降低协调成本并占据零碎时段 → 线下文化仍由身份、社交和场所体验支撑 → 结果更可能是时段替代与分层,而非一种媒介全面取代文化。

en.audience: Affected population = organizations and users across chips,equipment,materials,cloud services,manufacturing,and public infrastructure,a billion-scale impact reach;actual repeated actor/behaviour denominator = specialist organizations conducting process transfer,procurement,validation,and capacity allocation,not a personal action
en.falsifier: If by 2032,in at least three advanced-manufacturing ecosystems,newly substituted material or equipment paths achieve at least 90% of the incumbent path’s deliverable output for two consecutive years without public yield,conversion-time,and utility-redundancy validation,and the gap between capacity announcements and shipments is not material,“validated paths precede nominal expansion” is falsified;if firms do not disclose these measures,indeterminate rather than passed.
en.judgment: From 2027 to 2035,expansion of advanced chips and critical materials is more likely to be constrained first by jointly validated electronic-grade conversion,equipment service,process yield,water,and climate-resilience paths than by the number of announced fabs;only validated substitution paths and stable yield turn nominal capacity into deliverable output.
en.leading_indicator: Alternative-path certification time,yield and shipments,equipment-service substitutability,water and utility redundancy,actual loss after climate events,long-term procurement,and insurance terms;quarterly / annual.
en.reasoning_chain: Critical materials and equipment are often shared conversion nodes or by-products → inventory,a fab,or a second supplier is substitutable only after electronic-grade specifications,recipes,equipment service,and yield are validated → water,climate,and utility interruptions turn nominal capacity into actual loss → the next supply-chain competition therefore centers on validated conversion paths and stable yield,not only announced wafers,megawatts,or buildings.

zh.audience: 受影响人口=芯片、设备、材料、云服务、制造业与公共基础设施中的组织及其用户,十亿量级影响面;实际重复执行者/行为分母=参与工艺转移、采购、验证与产能调度的专业组织,不是个人动作
zh.falsifier: 若到 2032 年,至少 3 个先进制造生态中,新增替代材料/设备路径在没有公开良率、转化周期和公用工程冗余验证的情况下,仍能在连续两年达到既有路径 90% 以上的可交付产出,并且产能公告与实际出货偏差不显著,则“验证路径先于名义扩产”被证伪;若企业不披露这些指标,记为不可判定而非通过。
zh.judgment: 2027-2035 年,先进芯片与关键材料的扩产更可能先被电子级转化、设备服务、工艺良率、用水与气候韧性等共同验证的路径约束,而不是单纯被宣布的厂房数量约束;只有当替代路径和稳定良率被验证,名义产能才会转化为可交付产出。
zh.leading_indicator: 替代路径认证周期、良率与出货量、设备服务可替代性、用水和公用工程冗余、气候事件后的实际减产、长期采购与保险条款;季度/年度。
zh.reasoning_chain: 关键材料和设备往往是共同转化节点或副产品链 → 厂房、库存和第二供应商只有在电子级规格、配方、设备服务与良率被验证后才可替代 → 用水、气候和公用工程中断会把名义产能变成实际损失 → 因而供应链的下一阶段竞争先围绕可验证转化路径与稳定良率,而非只围绕宣布的 MW、晶圆片或厂房数量。

en.audience: Religious and secular organisations shape identity,rituals,family norms,care mutual aid,and public services for a billion-scale affected population;actual repeated actor/behaviour denominator = people who,under one comparable survey definition,attend worship,pray,take part in a rite,or use religious/secular community mutual aid at least monthly;a cross-country deduplicated denominator is not yet available,so the billion-scale impact reach is not a billion-person weekly-adoption claim
en.falsifier: If by 2035,in at least ten societies across four regions with at least two comparable survey waves,all four measures-affiliation,monthly practice,intergenerational transmission,and community participation-are each at least 20% below their 2025 baseline,while neither religious nor secular organisations retain material functions in marriage/funerals,mutual aid,care,or identity norms,and migration groups and younger cohorts show no offsetting differentiation,the claim that differentiation and functional recombination precede synchronous decline is falsified;non-aligned survey definitions or one-wave evidence is indeterminate.
en.judgment: From 2027 to 2035,education,urbanisation,and abundant online content will not make religious affiliation and practice decline synchronously worldwide;in multi-country samples with comparable repeated surveys,intergenerational transmission,ritual frequency,migration networks,and community supply are more likely to differentiate and recombine first,while lower formal affiliation will not proportionally eliminate religion’s identity,mutual-aid,and normative functions.
en.leading_indicator: Affiliation and monthly practice by age,education,migration background,and place;intergenerational transmission;coverage of marriage/funerals,care,charity,and mutual aid;retention,exit,and entry in religious and secular communities;annual or biennial.
en.reasoning_chain: Education,urbanisation,and state-service expansion weaken some religious organisations’ monopoly over knowledge and public affairs → fixed rituals and intergenerational transmission decline for some groups → marriage,funerals,mutual aid,moral identity,migration networks,and crisis care still require organisational carriers → religious organisations,secular charities,state services,and digital communities compete over those functions → demography,migration,regulation,and family transmission differentiate outcomes by society and generation → practice,organisational boundaries,and functions therefore reorganise before a synchronous global move to “no belief. ”

zh.audience: 宗教与世俗组织所影响的身份、仪式、家庭规范、照护互助与公共服务覆盖十亿量级人口;实际重复执行者/行为分母=在同一调查口径下每月至少一次参加礼拜、祈祷、仪式或宗教/世俗共同体互助的人,当前缺少跨国去重分母,不能把十亿量级影响面写成十亿级周频普及
zh.falsifier: 若到 2035 年,在至少 10 个分布于 4 个地区且拥有两轮以上可比调查的社会中,归属、月度实践、代际传递和共同体参与四项指标都相对 2025 基线下降至少 20%,并且宗教或世俗组织均未在婚丧、互助、照护和身份规范上承接可观功能,且迁移群体与年轻队列没有抵消性分化,则“先分化与功能重组、而非全球同步消退”被证伪;调查口径不能对齐或仅有单轮数据时记为不可判定。
zh.judgment: 2027-2035 年,教育、城市化与线上内容丰富不会使宗教归属和实践在全球同步消退;在有可比追踪调查的多国样本中,代际传递、仪式频次、迁移网络与共同体供给更可能先发生分化与重组,正式归属的下降不会等比例消除宗教的身份、互助与规范功能。
zh.leading_indicator: 按年龄、教育、迁移背景与地区拆分的归属和月度实践频次;跨代传递率;婚丧、照护、慈善与互助服务覆盖;宗教与世俗共同体的成员留存、退出与转入;每年或每两年。
zh.reasoning_chain: 教育、城市化与国家服务扩张削弱部分宗教组织对知识和公共事务的垄断 → 某些群体的固定仪式与代际传递下降 → 婚丧、互助、伦理身份、迁移网络与危机照护仍需要组织载体 → 宗教组织、世俗公益组织、国家服务与数字社群竞争这些功能 → 人口结构、迁移、规制与家庭传递使结果按社会和世代分化 → 因而先观察到实践、组织边界与功能的重组,而不是全球同步“无信仰”。

en.audience: A billion-scale affected population bears consequences for personal safety,property loss,mobility,and trust in strangers;actual repeated actor/behaviour denominator = deduplicated people reporting at least one incident of violence,property crime,online fraud,or enforcement contact per year in a comparable victimisation survey;a common cross-country denominator is not available,so the billion-scale impact reach is not a billion-person weekly-adoption claim
en.falsifier: If by 2035,in at least four groups of societies with different institutions,with at least two societies per group and two or more comparable waves,visible street violence,online-fraud victimisation,identity-theft losses,and reporting-adjusted overall victimisation all decline by at least 20%,and the improvement occurs mainly where cross-institution recovery,appeal,and responsibility boundaries did not strengthen,then the claim that risk recombination precedes overall safety improvement and governance intermediaries determine the result is falsified;reports,one-platform interception rates,or a single-year change alone are indeterminate.
en.judgment: From 2027 to 2035,visible street violence may fall or remain low in some high-income cities,while online fraud,identity theft,and organised property crime are more likely to move or expand across groups and platforms;overall public safety will depend on reporting,recovery,cross-institution responsibility,and lawful appeal improving together,not on one policing or AI technology.
en.leading_indicator: Victimisation surveys by age,income,migration background,and place;lethal and non-lethal violence;online-fraud reports and actual losses;identity theft and recovery rates;platform false interceptions,police contact,and appeal outcomes;perceived safety and stranger-transaction behaviour;annual or quarterly.
en.reasoning_chain: Demography and urban space change exposure → education,employment,and community support change conflict and accessible opportunities → police,courts,platforms,and insurers change detection,reporting,and recovery → digital identity,sensors,and generative tools lower evidence and defence costs on one side while lowering the threshold for fraud and forgery on the other → risk recombines among streets,homes,institutions,and platforms,separating victimisation,records,and perceived safety → only when cross-institution responsibility,lawful appeal,cross-border recovery,and victim support improve together can detection become lower actual harm.

zh.audience: 人身安全、财产损失、出行与陌生人信任受其影响的人口为十亿量级;实际重复执行者/行为分母=在同一口径受害调查中每年报告至少一次暴力、财产犯罪、线上诈骗或执法接触的去重个人,当前缺少跨国统一分母,不能把十亿量级影响面写成十亿级周频普及
zh.falsifier: 若到 2035 年,在至少 4 个制度不同的地区组、每组至少 2 个有两轮以上可比数据的社会中,可见街头暴力、线上诈骗受害率、身份盗用损失和报告偏差调整后的总体受害率都持续下降至少 20%,且这种改善主要发生在没有跨机构追偿、申诉和责任边界增强的地方,则“风险重组先于总体安全改善、治理中介决定结果”的判断被证伪;若只有报案数、单一平台拦截率或单年数据变化,记为不可判定。
zh.judgment: 2027-2035 年,部分高收入城市的可见街头暴力可能下降或保持低位,但线上诈骗、身份盗用与组织化财产犯罪更可能在不同人群和平台之间转移或扩张;公共安全的总体改善取决于报案、追偿、跨机构责任和合法申诉是否同步增强,而不是取决于单一警务或 AI 技术。
zh.leading_indicator: 按年龄、收入、迁移背景与地区拆分的受害调查;致命与非致命暴力;线上诈骗报告数与实际损失;身份盗用与追偿率;平台误拦截、警务接触与申诉结果;安全感和陌生人交易行为;年度或季度。
zh.reasoning_chain: 年龄结构与城市空间改变暴露 → 教育、就业与社区支持改变冲突和可进入机会 → 警察、法院、平台与保险改变发现、报案与追偿 → 数字身份、传感器与生成工具一方面降低取证与防御成本,另一方面降低诈骗与伪造门槛 → 风险在街道、家庭、机构和平台之间重组,受害、记录与安全感分离 → 只有跨机构责任、合法申诉、跨境追偿与受害者支持同时增强,技术发现能力才可能转化为实际伤害下降。

en.audience: The impact reach includes internet users who passively see AI summaries on search pages,a constructed billion-scale reach that is not counted in the denominator;the actual repeated actors are de-duplicated individuals who,at least once in 7 days,on their own initiative ask a general-purpose AI chat assistant a question or hand it a task - a single service’s self-reported lower bound is above 900 million,hundred-millions-scale (the S-tier threshold is 100 million;the lower bound is self-reported and unaudited,and services may not be added together).
en.falsifier: Any one of the following falsifies the corresponding part of this card:(1) before 2029-10-10,any platform publicly reports at least 100 million de-duplicated weekly users who order or pay through an AI on their behalf (overturns “delegated payment does not reach a hundred million weekly in the window”);(2) evidence independent of the providers - an audit,a regulatory disclosure,or a survey with a stated sampling design multiplied by a citable population base - shows that every single service’s de-duplicated weekly denominator was below 100 million at T (overturns “the S tier was reached at T”);(3) within the window,one of the three largest general-purpose chat assistants removes its free tier,and its publicly reported weekly active users are still at least 100 million a year after removal (overturns “the free tier is a necessary premise”;if no service removes its free tier within the window,this item is recorded as undeterminable,not as passed);(4) with the free tier still in place,every qualifying measure falls below 100 million by 2029-10-10 (overturns “it stays at the S tier”).
en.judgment: As of 2026-10-10,“on one’s own initiative,asking a general-purpose AI chat assistant a question or handing it a task” has reached the S tier (a single service self-reports more than 900 million weekly active users;the lower bound is self-reported and unaudited);as long as the free tier exists,it stays above a hundred million people weekly through 2029-10-10;while “handing a purchase or booking to an AI to place and pay for” does not reach a hundred million people weekly in the same window - what has reached society scale is asking and handing off low-stakes tasks,not deciding for people and not paying for them.
en.leading_indicator: Providers’ published weekly active users and consumer-subscriber counts (if a single service’s paying users reach 100 million,the free tier stops being a necessary premise and this card must be rewritten);changes to free-tier terms (quotas,ads,removal);survey shares for “used in the past week” with stated sampling designs,plus citable population bases;whether any platform starts publishing de-duplicated weekly users of AI ordering/payment on someone’s behalf;search-query series independent of the providers;annually.
en.reasoning_chain: The need to find answers and to get help writing something predates AI,and searching and asking people are its old actions (L8;no change in human nature required) → general-purpose chat assistants enter phones and browsers that are already ubiquitous through a free tier,and adoption needs no one else to change at the same time (a constraint) → one question replaces one search or one request to a person,and voluntary repeat use rose through 2023-2026 (self-reported weekly users 100 million → more than 900 million) → but answers can be wrong,and anything with consequences needs someone accountable (L8’s “certainty” and “accountability”) → the society-scale action stops at asking and handing off low-stakes tasks;deciding (an upstream condition) and ordering-and-paying on someone’s behalf need authorisation,revocation,and a liable party (an upstream condition),and neither clears a constraint at T → the necessary premise of the scale is the free tier:counting payers only gives a self-reported lower bound above 59 million at T and,at a paying share of about 5 percent,stays in the tens of millions,which would drop the result to the D tier.

zh.audience: 影响面包括被动看到搜索页 AI 摘要的上网人口,构造式十亿量级,不计入分母;实际重复执行者为 7 天内至少一次主动向通用 AI 对话助手提问或交办任务的去重个人,单一服务自报下限超 9 亿,属亿量级(S 档门槛为 1 亿;下限来自自报、未审计,跨服务不得相加)。
zh.falsifier: 以下任一条成立,即证伪本卡对应的那一部分:(1) 2029-10-10 之前,任一平台公开报告「每周代下单或代付款的去重用户」≥ 1 亿(推翻「代付在窗口内达不到亿级周频」);(2) 出现独立于服务方的证据--审计、监管披露,或有抽样说明的调查乘以可引用的人口基数--显示 T 时任一单一服务的去重周分母都低于 1 亿(推翻「T 时已达 S 档」);(3) 窗口内前三大通用对话助手之一取消免费档,取消满一年时该服务公开的周活仍 ≥ 1 亿(推翻「免费档是必要前提」;窗口内若没有任何服务取消免费档,此条记为不可判定,不记为通过);(4) 免费档仍在的情况下,到 2029-10-10 所有合格口径都跌破 1 亿(推翻「仍停在 S 档」)。
zh.judgment: 截至 2026-10-10,「本人主动向通用 AI 对话助手提问或交办一项任务」已达 S 档(单一服务自报周活超 9 亿,下限来自自报、未审计);只要免费档仍在,到 2029-10-10 它仍停在亿级周频之上;而「把一次购物或订票交给 AI 代为下单付款」在同一窗口内达不到亿级周频--达到社会级的是「问」和交办低后果任务,不是替人拍板,也不是替人付钱。
zh.leading_indicator: 服务方公开的周活与付费消费者订阅者人数(若单一服务的付费者达到 1 亿,免费档不再是必要前提,本卡须改写);免费档条款的变化(额度、广告、取消);有抽样说明的「过去一周使用过」调查比例及可引用的人口基数;平台是否开始公开代下单/代付款的每周去重用户;独立于服务方的搜索查询量序列;每年。
zh.reasoning_chain: 找答案、找人帮忙写东西的需求早于 AI 存在,搜索与问人是它的旧动作(L8,不要求人性改变)→ 通用对话助手以免费档进入早已普及的手机与浏览器,采用不需要任何他人同时改变(一道约束、一道约束)→ 一次提问替代一次搜索或一次求人,自愿重复使用在 2023-2026 年持续上升(自报周活 1 亿→超 9 亿)→ 但答案可能出错,有后果的事需要有人负责(L8 的「确定性」与「责任归属」)→ 社会级的动作停在「问」和交办低后果任务;拍板(an upstream condition)与代下单付款需要授权、撤回与责任承接(an upstream condition),在 T 时都过不了一道约束 → 规模的必要前提是免费档:只数付费者,T 时自报下限超过 5,900 万,按约 5% 的付费比例停在千万级,结果会落到 D 档。

en.audience: The affected population is a constructed tens-of-millions impact reach of workers and service users in these sectors. Actual repeated actors are workers in adoption-dense regions performing the measured task segment weekly;current occupation and deployment data can construct no more than a million-scale denominator,not society-scale diffusion.
en.falsifier: By 2033,across at least three sectors and three institutional settings,adoption-dense regions show neither repeatable task re-bundling nor replacement of any defined action;or comparable cross-sector whole-occupation losses appear after demand,price,and institutional explanations are excluded.
en.judgment: From 2027-2035,embodied systems are more likely to remove repetitive,hand-off-able task segments in warehousing,manufacturing,agriculture,and care,then re-bundle exception handling,relationship work,and responsibility sign-off;capability curves alone will not eliminate whole occupations at the same time.
en.leading_indicator: Robot hours,human takeover minutes,exception wages,downtime loss,training hours,and headcount recorded by task segment;annually.
en.reasoning_chain: Structured,hand-off-able tasks clear unit economics first → task bundles split inside occupations → human time moves toward exceptions,relationships,and liability → employment depends simultaneously on demand,prices,and organisational choice → net employment cannot be inferred from robot capability alone.

zh.audience: 受影响人群为上述行业劳动者与服务接受者,构造式千万量级影响面;实际重复执行者是采用密集地区中每周执行被测任务段的劳动者,当前只能从职业与设备部署口径构造百万量级以内分母,不能声称社会级普及。 具体而言,提高既有专业者在异常与责任任务上的上限,也把部分结构化动作交给原本不做该动作的设备系统。
zh.falsifier: 到 2033 年,在至少三个上述行业、三个制度环境中,具身采用密集地区的职业总量与任务结构均未出现可重复的任务重排,且设备始终只增加而不替代任何可定义动作;或出现跨行业、可比的整职业净减少,并能排除需求、价格和制度变化的解释。
zh.judgment: 2027-2035 年,具身系统更可能先替掉仓储、制造、农业与照护职业中重复且可接管的任务段,再重排异常处理、关系维护与责任签字;它不会仅凭能力曲线同步消灭整个职业。
zh.leading_indicator: 按任务段而非职业记录的机器人作业小时、人工接管分钟、异常处理工资、停机损失、培训时长与岗位总量;每年。
zh.reasoning_chain: 结构化且失败可接管的动作先过单位成本 → 职业内部任务包被拆分 → 人工时间转向异常、关系和责任 → 岗位数量同时受需求扩张、价格变化和组织选择影响 → 净就业方向不能从机器人能力单独推出。

en.audience: The affected population is a constructed tens-of-millions impact reach of workers,firms,service users,and local governments in embodied sectors. Actual repeated actors are people performing equipment work,takeover,or liability review weekly inside adoption-dense organisations;no cross-sector deduplicated denominator exists,so the repeated-actor denominator remains million-scale at most and this remains occupational/organisational. specifically,it raises existing asset and liability holders' ceiling,not equal bargaining power for people without those assets.
en.falsifier: By 2035,across at least three embodied sectors,income,wages,prices,and public services no longer relate to control of complementary assets,finance,and liability;or sustained,replicable gain diffusion first appears among actors without those assets.
en.judgment: From 2028-2038,embodied productivity gains are more likely to flow first to complementary assets and liability carriers controlling worksites,order access,finance,insurance,and maintenance,with competition,wage bargaining,and public institutions deciding whether they spread.
en.leading_indicator: Equipment leasing and ownership,accident/downtime clauses in per-unit contracts,maintenance and insurance margins,worker wages and hours,service prices,and local public spending;annually.
en.reasoning_chain: Embodied capability earns revenue only inside sites,orders,and liability structures → organisations able to finance,insure,and absorb downtime adopt first → scarce carrying bundles gain bargaining power → gains concentrate first → competition,unions,and public institutions determine conversion into wages,lower prices,shorter hours,or public services.

zh.audience: 受影响人群为具身采用行业的劳动者、企业、服务使用者与地方财政,构造式千万量级影响面;实际重复执行者为在采用密集组织中每周执行设备任务、接管或责任审核的人,当前没有跨行业去重分母,只能按职业/组织层判断。 具体而言,提高已有资产与责任承载者的收益上限,不让原本没有这些资产的人直接获得同等议价权。
zh.falsifier: 到 2035 年,在至少三个具身采用行业中,收益、工资、价格和公共服务变化不再与互补资产控制、融资能力和责任承载有关;或在缺少这些资产的主体中先出现持续且可复制的收益扩散。
zh.judgment: 2028-2038 年,具身生产率收益更可能先流向拥有作业场所、订单入口、融资、保险与维护网络的互补资产和责任承载者,再由竞争、工资谈判与公共制度决定是否扩散。
zh.leading_indicator: 设备租赁与所有权结构、按件合同中的事故与停机责任、维护和保险利润率、劳动者工资与工时、服务价格、地方公共支出;每年。
zh.reasoning_chain: 具身能力只有嵌入场所、订单和责任结构才能产生收入 → 能承受融资、保险和停机的组织先采用 → 稀缺承载组合获得议价权 → 收益先集中 → 竞争、工会与公共制度才决定是否转为工资、低价、短工时或公共服务。

en.audience: actual repeated actors/behaviour denominator = not applicable,because this card judges demographic outcomes and institutional combinations rather than a weekly deduplicated social action
en.falsifier: Pre-register the denominator as the 38 OECD members in the 2024 edition. By 2035,if at least 26 members have total fertility rates at or above 2. 1 for three consecutive years,and both an age-standardised series and a native-born/immigrant composition split still rise (rather than the rise being explained only by age structure,migrant composition,or measurement change),the direction that most remain below replacement is refuted. A few countries reaching 2. 1 would not refute the majority claim but would require narrowing the institutional-combination boundary;countries without comparable component data do not enter the numerator,and missingness is not counted as success.
en.judgment: By 2035,total fertility rates will remain below 2. 1 in most OECD countries;the more plausible policy result is to reduce postponement caused by housing,childcare,and work conflicts and to make some countries higher than comparable countries without complementary policy,rather than return the OECD as a whole to replacement fertility.
en.leading_indicator: OECD total fertility rates,age at first birth,and childlessness;childcare enrolment and household out-of-pocket cost;housing burden;female employment and income loss after parental leave;annually.
en.reasoning_chain: Longer education and employment paths delay partnership and parenthood → the opportunity and housing costs of children are concentrated into a shorter life stage → a single cash policy covers only part of the price and cannot replace childcare,partnership,or predictable work → France and Nordic combinations show that the gap can be partly compressed;low fertility in Singapore,Japan,and South Korea shows that a single incentive does not automatically restore replacement fertility → the more likely future is modest timing recovery and wider country differences,not a broad OECD rebound.

zh.audience: 实际重复执行者/行为分母=不适用,本卡判断人口结果与制度组合,不是按周去重的社会动作
zh.falsifier: 把分母预注册为 2024 版 OECD 的 38 个成员;到 2035 年,若至少 26 个成员的总和生育率达到或超过 2. 1 并连续三年维持,且年龄标准化序列与本国出生/移民构成拆分仍同时上升(不是只由年龄结构、移民构成或统计口径变化造成),则证伪「多数仍低于替代水平」的方向。 只有少数国家达到 2. 1 不足以证伪多数国家判断,但会迫使本卡收窄制度组合边界;缺少可比拆分数据的国家不计入分子,也不把缺失当成成功。
zh.judgment: 到 2035 年,多数 OECD 国家总和生育率仍低于 2. 1;更可行的政策结果是减少因住房、托育和工作冲突而推迟生育的缺口,并让部分国家高于没有配套政策的同类国家,而不是把整个 OECD 带回人口替代水平。
zh.leading_indicator: OECD 总和生育率、首胎年龄、无子比例;托育入托率与家庭自付成本;住房负担;女性就业与父母休假后的收入损失;每年。
zh.reasoning_chain: 教育和就业年限延长、婚育时间推迟 → 育儿的机会成本与住房成本集中在更短的生命阶段 → 单一现金政策只能补一部分价格,不能替代托育、伴侣关系和可预期工作 → 法国及北欧的组合式制度说明缺口可以被部分压缩;新加坡、日本与韩国的低生育说明单点激励不能自动恢复替代水平 → 未来更可能出现国家间差距扩大和出生时间小幅前移,而非 OECD 普遍反弹。

en.audience: Affected population = workers and users in manufacturing,logistics,agriculture,construction,care,and household services,a billion-scale impact reach;actual repeated actor/behaviour denominator = organizations and frontline operators deploying and maintaining the systems,with no common cross-sector denominator yet,so this is not a claim of society-wide adoption
en.falsifier: If,in at least five economies with adequate public statistics,by 2032 open-home or open-construction multi-task embodied systems exceed fixed-workcell or controlled-institution single-task systems in organizations with 12-month retention,weekly repeated use,and continued deployment after an incident,without relying on one-off pilot subsidies,the “controlled single-task first” ordering is falsified;missing comparable retention and repetition denominators means indeterminate.
en.judgment: From 2027 to 2035,embodied systems are more likely to stabilize first as calibrated single-task loops in workcells,warehouses,institutions,and controlled services,then expand into multi-task robots for open homes,construction sites,and care;one successful demonstration is not a retained,society-scale service.
en.leading_indicator: New installations by setting,12-month retention,human-takeover minutes,incident and downtime rates,maintenance-contract renewal,task boundaries,and permission clauses;semiannual / annual.
en.reasoning_chain: A fixed workcell lets operators calibrate space,objects,tempo,and failure exits → a single-task device can use a safety fence,human takeover,and a maintenance contract to absorb exceptions → an open environment exposes perception,grasping,liability,cleaning,coordination,and safety boundaries at once → more task combinations raise verification and liability costs → repeatable closed loops therefore arrive before general open-world operation.

zh.audience: 受影响人口=制造、物流、农业、建筑、照护和家庭服务中的劳动者与使用者,十亿量级影响面;实际重复执行者/行为分母=部署并维护该系统的组织与一线操作人员,当前没有跨行业同一动作分母,不能声称社会级普及
zh.falsifier: 若在至少 5 个公开统计充分的经济体中,到 2032 年开放家庭或开放建筑现场的多任务具身系统,按连续 12 个月留存、每周重复使用和事故后仍继续部署的组织数量,均超过固定工位/受控机构单任务系统,且不依赖单一试点补贴,则“受控单任务先行”被证伪;没有可比的留存和重复使用分母时记为不可判定。
zh.judgment: 2027-2035 年,具身系统更可能先在工位、仓内、机构和受控服务中以可标定的单任务闭环稳定部署,再向开放家庭、建筑现场和照护中的多任务通用机器人扩展;“能完成一次演示”不等于形成可留存的社会级服务。
zh.leading_indicator: 按场景拆分的新装机、12 个月留存率、人工接管分钟数、事故与停机率、维护合同续约率、任务边界与权限条款;半年/年度。
zh.reasoning_chain: 固定工位能预先标定空间、物体、节拍和失败出口 → 单任务设备可用围栏、人工接管与维护合同吸收异常 → 开放环境把感知、抓取、责任、清洁、协作和安全边界同时暴露 → 任务组合越多,验证与责任成本越高 → 因而可重复闭环先于通用开放世界。

en.audience: Affected population = urban commuters,carers,households with children or older adults,transit users,and local transport authorities,a **billion-scale** impact reach;repeated-action denominator = unique adults and households making a commute,care,or shopping trip at least weekly,for which no cross-city common denominator exists,so this is not a claim of a billion weekly actions
en.falsifier: In at least 12 pre-registered high-income cities,if,relative to the 2024-2026 baseline,reliability,affordability,and care-trip access improve by at least 10% for every income and care-responsibility group for three consecutive years,while differences in mode mix and cancellation/disruption also do not widen,then the direction that reliability and care responsibility produce stratification rather than single-mode substitution is falsified;without a common household denominator or subgroup data,record it as undecidable.
en.judgment: From 2027 to 2035,in high-income cities with comparable data,commuting,care,and shopping trips are more likely to stratify by reliability,affordability,residential density,and care responsibility;lower-income households and households making frequent care trips will first absorb waiting,transfer,and disruption costs,rather than everyone automatically switching to one transport mode.
en.leading_indicator: On-time performance,waiting and transfer time,trip cost/income ratio,road and transit disruption days,care-trip access,mode mix,and cancellation rate by income and care responsibility;quarterly/annual.
en.reasoning_chain: Residential geography and care responsibilities fix trips that must happen → road capacity,transit frequency,energy prices,and extreme weather jointly change reliability and cost → households with less time slack and greater care responsibility absorb waiting,transfers,and cancellations first → households combine modes and adjust activity radii rather than synchronously switching to one mode when a technology appears → transport inequality first appears as unequal access to reliable arrival.

zh.audience: 受影响人口=城市通勤者、照护者、儿童与老年人家庭、公共交通使用者和地方交通管理者,十亿量级影响面;实际重复执行者/行为分母=每周至少一次通勤、照护或购物出行的去重成年人及其家庭,当前没有跨城市统一分母,不能声称十亿级周频动作
zh.falsifier: 在预注册的至少 12 个高收入城市中,若相对 2024-2026 基线,连续三年各收入组和照护责任组的出行可靠性、可负担性与照护出行可达率同步改善至少 10%,且方式组合差异与取消/中断差异不扩大,则“可靠性与照护责任造成分层、而非单一方式替代”的方向被证伪;缺少统一家庭分母或分组数据时记为不可判定。
zh.judgment: 2027-2035 年,在有可比数据的高收入城市,通勤、照护和购物出行更可能按可靠性、可负担性、居住密度与照护责任分层;低收入家庭和需要频繁照护出行的家庭先承受等待、换乘与出行中断成本,而不是全体自动转向某一种交通方式。
zh.leading_indicator: 按收入与照护责任分组的准点率、等待与换乘时间、出行费用/收入比、道路与公共交通中断天数、照护出行可达率、方式组合和取消率;季度/年度。
zh.reasoning_chain: 居住分布与照护责任固定了必须发生的出行 → 道路容量、公共交通班次、能源价格和极端天气共同改变可靠性与成本 → 时间余量更少、照护责任更高的家庭先吸收等待、换乘与取消风险 → 家庭会组合多种方式并调整活动半径,而不是因为某项技术出现就同步换成一种方式 → 交通不平等首先表现为可可靠到达的机会差异。

en.audience: The affected population is a constructed tens-of-millions impact reach of recipients,family members,and care workers. Actual repeated actors are adults performing hands-on care,coordination,or device takeover weekly;the countable part-"providing unpaid care to an elderly,ill or disabled family member or friend" each week-is,under the definition frozen on 2026-10-10,about 31 million across the US and the UK combined,which is tens-of-millions-scale (see M2 in §3 of the verdict on social actions that do not presuppose AI),while "device takeover" itself has no count at all;comparable OECD surveys cover limited subgroups and cannot be extrapolated to global hundred-million-scale action. specifically,it raises existing care professionals' ceiling and coordinators' ceiling,rather than broadly granting autonomous care authority to people who previously carried no such responsibility.
en.falsifier: By 2035,in at least three institutional settings,open-home care devices continuously perform three or more cross-space tasks,while hands-on,coordination,and exception-decision time all fall materially and retention and incidents are no worse than institutional deployments. Demonstrations and single-task devices do not falsify it.
en.judgment: From 2027-2038,if embodied care assistance stabilises,it will first shift some family members’ hands-on work toward authorisation,coordination,payment,and exception decisions rather than removing family care relationships as a whole.
en.leading_indicator: Months of continuous home use,cross-space success,human takeover,coordination time,care leave,incidents,and maintenance cost;annually.
en.reasoning_chain: Care demand rises while family time is constrained → formal services carry some continuous actions → institutions deploy before open homes → family members shift toward authority and exception decisions → relationships and liability do not disappear when one task is automated.

zh.audience: 受影响人群为被照护者、家庭成员和照护劳动者,构造式千万量级影响面;实际重复执行者是每周执行亲手照护、协调或设备接管的成年人;其中「每周为一位高龄、患病或失能的家人或亲友提供无酬照料」这一可数部分,按 2026-10-10 冻结口径美、英两国合格合计约 3,100 万,属千万量级(见不以 AI 为前提的社会动作判定 §3 的 M2),「设备接管」本身尚无任何计数;现有 OECD 可比调查只覆盖有限调查子群,不能外推全球亿级。 具体而言,提高既有照护专业者与家庭协调者上限,不让原本不承担责任的人普遍获得自主照护权。
zh.falsifier: 到 2035 年,在至少三个制度环境中,开放家庭照护设备持续承担三类以上跨空间任务,且家庭亲手、协调和异常决策时长均显著下降、留存与事故率不劣于机构;只有演示或单任务设备不算推翻。
zh.judgment: 2027-2038 年,具身照护辅助若形成稳定部署,会先把家庭成员的一部分亲手执行转为授权、协调、支付与异常决策,而不是让家庭照护关系整体退出。
zh.leading_indicator: 家庭设备持续使用月数、任务跨空间成功率、人工接管率、协调时长、照护请假、事故与维护成本;每年。
zh.reasoning_chain: 照护需求增加且家庭可用时间受限 → 正式服务承接部分连续动作 → 机构先于开放家庭部署 → 家庭成员从执行者转为授权和异常决策者 → 关系与责任不因一段动作自动化而消失。

en.audience: The impact reach includes current recipients of public pensions in the G7 and working contributors who are not yet drawing,a constructed hundred-millions-scale reach (estimated from each country's population structure;head counts were not verified country by country this round),not counted in the denominator of any weekly action;this card judges legislative and budget behaviour,not an individual action,and the direct deciders are the legislatures and governments of the seven countries. it judges whether an income already promised will be cut in nominal terms,and on which generation the burden of a cut falls.
en.falsifier: Any one of the following falsifies the corresponding part of this card:(1) within the window,any G7 country (the US,Japan,Germany,the UK,France,Italy,Canada) that,at the time of legislating,can borrow on the market and is not in a creditor assistance programme passes new legislation that brings the monthly nominal amount of the median current recipient's basic public pension below the previous period - an indexation formula written in by new legislation and triggered within the window also counts;written in advance as **not counting**:automatic rules already in force at T (the Japan fiscal 2022 kind),cuts that apply only to high pensions (the Italy 2019 kind),and tax changes;(2) within the window,US Social Security retirement beneficiaries are paid less than the amount due under law,or are paid late,because a trust fund is depleted - congressional **inaction** counts too;(3) a Social Security solvency bill passed in the US within the window contains a provision cutting the nominal monthly benefits of people already drawing;(4) for a solvency bill passed in the US within the window,the scoring by the Social Security Administration's Chief Actuary shows that more than half of the long-term benefit-side savings come from people already drawing at the time of enactment (if the scoring has no such breakdown,this item is recorded as undeterminable,not as passed). At the due check,it must be recorded truthfully whether any G7 member lost market financing or entered a creditor programme within the window;this exclusion may not be used as an excuse after the fact.
en.judgment: From 2026-10-10 to 2034-12-31,no G7 country that can still borrow on the market and is not in a creditor assistance programme passes new legislation that lowers the nominal amount of the median current recipient's basic public pension;the US Old-Age and Survivors Insurance (OASI) trust fund is projected to be depleted in the fourth quarter of 2032,this gap will not be resolved in a way that leaves people already drawing with less than the amount due under law,and at least half of the long-term benefit-side savings of any fix come from people who have not yet started drawing at the time of enactment.
en.leading_indicator: The depletion year and payable share in the annual US Social Security Trustees Report;solvency bills introduced in Congress and the Chief Actuary's scoring;pension indexation provisions and freeze proposals in the annual budgets of the seven countries;each country's long-term government bond yields and sovereign rating actions;whether any G7 member applies for external assistance;annually.
en.reasoning_chain: Three bills - interest,ageing and defence - land on the same budget at once (US net interest exceeded defence in fiscal 2024 and 2025;OASI depleted in Q4 2032;NATO core defence of 3. 5% by 2035) → tax increases have a ceiling,so some spending must give up share → raising the pension age and changing future formulas falls on cohorts not yet drawing,and is the most common cut in the precedents (carried by no lens:L10's unit is the whole arrangement,and it does not judge sub-cohorts inside a pension;the precedents are the US in 1983,France in 2023 and China in 2024;Canada announced it in its 2012 budget and reversed it in 2016,and the 2005 US personal-accounts proposal,which touched only people under 55,still failed,which shows it is within reach but does not necessarily stick) → for current recipients,countries that can finance themselves switch to methods that never appear in a notification letter:threshold freezes (UK 2022),taxation of benefits and delayed adjustments (US 1983),and automatic formulas written before T (Japan,fiscal 2022,nominal -0. 4%);freezes proposed by governments also get deleted by parliaments (France 2026) - a nominal cut needs a visible vote (carried by no lens;the human-nature clause “loss aversion” has a source sentence) → nominal cuts by new legislation appear only in countries that have lost market financing and entered a creditor programme (Greece,Portugal;Ireland,also in a programme,did not cut the weekly rate of the State Pension in its 2011 budget either),or target only high pensions (Italy 2019) → so within the window,the US OASI gap will be resolved without cutting what current recipients are actually paid,and at least half of the long-term benefit-side savings of the fix come from people not yet drawing (carried by no lens,which is why is medium).

zh.audience: 影响面包括七国集团的公共养老金现领取者与尚未领取的在职缴费者,构造式亿量级(按各国人口结构估计,本轮未逐国核实人数),不计入任何周频动作的分母;本卡判断的是立法与预算行为,不是个人动作,直接决定者是七国的立法机构与政府。
zh.falsifier: 以下任一条成立,即证伪本卡对应的那一部分:(1) 窗口内,七国集团(美、日、德、英、法、意、加)中任一在立法时既能在市场上融资、又未处于债权人援助计划的国家,通过新立法使中位现领取者的基本公共养老金月度名义金额低于前一期--新立法写入、并在窗口内触发的指数化公式同样计入;事先写明**不计入**:T 时已生效的自动规则(日本 2022 财年那类)、只适用于高额养老金的削减(意大利 2019 年那类)、税收变化;(2) 窗口内,美国社会保障退休金领取者因信托基金耗尽而实收低于法定应付,或被延迟支付--国会**不作为**同样计入;(3) 窗口内美国通过的社会保障偿付能力法案含有削减已在领取者名义月度福利的条款;(4) 窗口内美国通过的偿付能力法案,按社会保障署首席精算师的评分,福利侧长期节省有一半以上来自立法时已在领取的人(评分没有这种分解时,此条记为不可判定,不记为通过)。 到期检查时须如实记录窗口内有没有七国成员失去市场融资或进入债权人计划,不得把这一排除条件当作事后借口。
zh.judgment: 2026-10-10 至 2034-12-31,在七国集团里,只要一个国家还能在市场上融资、没有进入债权人援助计划,就没有一国通过新立法让中位现领取者的基本公共养老金名义金额下降;美国老年与遗属保险信托基金(OASI)预计 2032 年第四季度耗尽,这一缺口的解决方式不会让已在领取的人实收低于法定应付,任何修补法案的福利侧长期节省至少一半来自立法时还没开始领取的人。
zh.leading_indicator: 美国社会保障年度受托人报告的耗尽年份与可支付比例;国会提交的偿付能力法案及首席精算师评分;七国年度预算中的养老金指数化条款与冻结提案;各国长期国债收益率与主权评级行动;是否有七国成员申请外部援助;每年。
zh.reasoning_chain: 利息、老龄化与国防三份账单同时落在同一本预算上(美国净利息 2024、2025 财年超过国防;OASI 2032 年第四季度耗尽;北约 2035 年核心国防 3. 5%)→ 加税有上限,总要有支出让出份额 → 提高领取年龄、改变未来公式落在尚未领取的队列身上,是先例里最常见的一刀(无承载:L10 的单位是整个安排,不判养老金内部的子队列;先例为美国 1983、法国 2023、中国 2024;加拿大 2012 年预算宣布、2016 年撤回,美国 2005 年只动 55 岁以下者的个人账户提案仍然失败,说明可达但不一定站得住)→ 对现领取者,能自主融资的国家改用不写进通知信的办法:门槛冻结(英国 2022)、福利计税与推迟调整(美国 1983)、T 之前写好的自动公式(日本 2022 财年名义 -0. 4%);政府提出的冻结也会被议会删掉(法国 2026)--名义削减需要一次看得见的投票(无承载,人性条文「损失厌恶」有源句)→ 新立法的名义削减只出现在失去市场融资、进入债权人计划的国家(希腊、葡萄牙;同在计划内的爱尔兰,2011 年预算也没有削国家养老金周额),或只针对高额养老金(意大利 2019)→ 所以窗口内,美国 OASI 缺口会以不削减现领取者实付的方式解决,修补的福利侧长期节省至少一半来自尚未领取的人(无承载,因此为中)。

en.falsifier: If by 2032,in at least five power markets with public capacity and commissioning data,newly commissioned dispatchable low-carbon or long-duration-storage capacity (actual MW and available MWh) exceeds the standardized-renewable-plus-short-duration combination for three consecutive years,with no longer average application-to-commercial-operation time and without relying mainly on one-off administrative compulsion,this ordering is falsified;if commissioned capacity cannot be separated from queued capacity,indeterminate.
en.judgment: From 2027 to 2035,in new power projects,standardized renewable generation plus short-duration electrochemical storage is more likely to form a repeatable local combination first;long-duration storage,nuclear,or other dispatchable low-carbon systems reaching comparable stable scale still require longer interconnection,permitting,financing,and operating-validation cycles.
en.leading_indicator: Interconnection-queue time,commissioned capacity by technology,storage-duration distribution,capacity-market or long-term contracts,permitting time,cancellation rates,and actual availability;quarterly / annual.
en.reasoning_chain: Standardized components can be procured,built in parallel,and deployed locally → short-duration storage first settles intraday mismatch and can be settled in existing markets → long-duration and dispatchable systems require longer interconnection queues,permits,fuel or geology validation,and capacity-accounting arrangements → reliability ultimately requires a portfolio of resources → “repeatable modules first,system-level firm capacity later” is more plausible than a single end-state technology arriving at once.

zh.judgment: 2027-2035 年,在新增电力项目中,标准化的可再生发电与短时电化学储能更可能先形成可复制的局部组合;跨季节储能、长时储能、核能或其他可调度低碳系统要成为同等规模的稳定替代,仍需更长的并网、许可、融资和运行验证周期。
